title: Top
body:
!!!Vorab!!!: die Voll-Version kostet in der gratis App 1,09€ im App-Store 2,29€.
Hab öfters Probleme aufzustehen oder drücke ich den normalen Wecker im Halbschlaf weg oder überhöre den Weckton, es ist erwiesen das sich gewisse Menschen Unterbewusst an den Ton gewöhnen und dann den Wecker unbewusst ausstellen ohne es zu merken.
Mit dieser App ist verschlafen oder wieder einschlafen Geschichte!
Super App!!👍🏻 viele verschiedene Funktionen und Auswahlmöglichkeiten für das Einstellen des Weckers. 
Man kann außerdem seine eigene Musik als Weckton wählen.
 Man ist gleich etwas wacher wenn man z.b erst einmal rechnen muss oder aufstehen um ein Bild z.b von einem Waschbecken zu machen.
Man startet nicht unbedingt entspannter aber schneller in den Tag.. ich meine: keiner macht vor dem ersten Kaffee gerne Denkaufgaben oder Kopfrechnen, jedoch für alle Menschen mit Problemen aus dem Bett zu kommen eine super App .
Ein weiteres Plus sind die beruhigenden Klänge die man auswählen kann um sich ruhig in den Schlaf fallen zu lassen— vom beruhigenden knisternden Feuer bis zum entspannten Abend Regen alles dabei.
Einzige Makel sind das sich das stumm schalten nicht einstellen lässt 
Ansonsten Danke an die Entwickler

Verbesserungen meinerseits wäre, dass man selbst Töne oder Musik zu den „Einschlaf-Tönen“  hinzufügen kann.
Und eine weiter super Funktion wo ich auch dafür bezahlen würde wäre, wenn der Wecker wie eine Art „Tageslicht“ Wecker funktionieren würde z.B eine Einstellbare Farbe oder Farbton welcher ansteigend heller wird bevor oder während der Wecker sich „steigert“
Macht das aufwachen definitiv angenehmer und die App wäre perfekt 

Mit freundlichen Grüßen 

Michi

body:
My phone is almost always on mute(hardware switch, because I can toggle it with the phone on my pocket), the problem for me is, that this also mutes the alarm.
I dont use timed DND because it will also stop my calls from vibrating.
If that doesn't apply to you, then I'd recommend the app. I have an irregular work week, and features like the "skip next alarm" button make it a considerable improvement over the stock app.

The App is very good, and I'll gladly come back to it once Apple decides to be less restrictive with their policies.

title: Denne alarm har helt oprigtigt forbedret mit liv/min hverdag/min døgnrytme
body:
Her følger min varmeste anbefaling (jeg bruger gratis-udgaven til iPhone og har kun haft den få dage):

Jeg er nok ikke den eneste, for hvem det er så godt som umuligt at stå op 
uden krav/deadlines udefra? 

Den her alarm-app kan man indstille til, at den først stopper med at ringe, når man har scannet en stregkode, fx på et produkt i køkkenet eller badeværelset - eller ude i skuret for den sags skyld. Når den ringer, kan man ‘slukke’ med det samme, så den fx ikke forstyrrer en slumrende partner, men den genoptager ringeriet ca 15 sek efter, hvis man ikke har scannet sin kode indenfor den tid. 

Man kan også bare tage et billede i stedet for at scanne, men det vil jeg ikke anbefale, for man skal virkelig tage det præcist ift sit reference-billede for, at appen godtager billedet som identisk; jeg måtte slette appen et par gange, fordi den ikke godtog mine billeder og blev ved med at ringe 😂

Der en masse andre ‘opgaver’ end stregkode-scanning, fx at løse matematik-opgaver, lave X antal squats eller andet for at vågne bedre op.

Og man kan vælge med og uden snooze. For mit vedkommende er det nødvendigt uden snooze, så jeg er tvunget til at stå op og scanne (dvs gå ud på badeværelset). Men man kan sætte flere alarmer, så det fx kun er den sidste, der er uden snooze ☺️

title: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5/5 — Alarmy Changed My Mornings and Nights! The Best Alarm App Ever 🌙⏰
body:
I can’t believe how much Alarmy has changed my life — both my mornings and my nights. I’ve tried dozens of alarm apps before, but nothing ever worked like this one. I used to sleep through alarms, hit snooze ten times, and start every day feeling rushed and stressed. But with Alarmy, I actually wake up on time, feel energized, and even sleep better at night.

🌄 My Mornings Are Completely Different

Now, waking up feels easy. Alarmy doesn’t let you snooze endlessly — it makes you do something before it stops ringing. You can choose “missions” like solving math problems, taking a picture of a specific place (like your bathroom or kitchen), shaking your phone, or even doing memory games. It sounds funny, but it’s genius. You literally can’t turn off the alarm without waking your brain up.

Before I knew it, I was out of bed, alert, and already smiling at how clever it was. I’ve never been a morning person, but now I actually enjoy getting up.

🌙 Better Nights Too — White Noise + Sleep Timer = Perfect Combo

What I didn’t expect was how Alarmy would also improve my nights. It’s not just about waking up — it also helps you fall asleep peacefully. There’s a built-in white noise feature with tons of relaxing sounds like rain, ocean waves, crackling fires, soft piano, and more. I usually choose gentle rain or forest sounds, and it instantly helps me relax.

Even better, you can set a timer so the white noise stops automatically after a while. That means I don’t have to worry about turning it off or wasting battery — I just set it, close my eyes, and drift off peacefully. It’s honestly one of my favorite parts of the app because it makes bedtime feel calm and cozy.

I used to scroll on my phone or overthink before sleeping, but now I put on my Alarmy sound, set the timer, and fall asleep so much faster. And since I know Alarmy will wake me up no matter what, I go to bed relaxed instead of anxious.

⏰ Customizable and Fun

Another thing I love is how personalized everything is. You can pick your alarm tone, volume, difficulty level, and even combine missions for a bigger challenge. You can create different alarms for weekdays, weekends, or naps, and set how long snoozes last. I even made a routine where I have to shake my phone 30 times and solve math problems before it turns off — it sounds crazy, but it totally works.

🧘 Morning Routine Mode = Productive Days

The “Morning Routine” mode is like having a little life coach in your pocket. It lets you plan your ideal start to the day — from brushing your teeth to stretching, journaling, or drinking water. The app gently guides you through each step so you begin your day feeling focused and accomplished. It’s one of those small habits that makes a huge difference over time.

💪 For Heavy Sleepers (and Procrastinators)

If you’re a deep sleeper, this app is your savior. It’s powerful, loud, and smart enough to make sure you actually wake up. I used to think nothing could make me stop hitting snooze — but Alarmy did. It’s perfect for students, busy people, or anyone who wants to get their mornings under control.

💎 Premium Is Totally Worth It

The free version is already amazing, but the Premium upgrade unlocks even more sounds, missions, and features. I went for it, and it’s 100% worth it. It’s honestly such a small price for how much peace, structure, and energy it brings to your days (and nights).

🌟 Final Thoughts

Alarmy isn’t just an alarm clock — it’s a complete sleep and wake-up system. It helps you go to bed relaxed, fall asleep to peaceful sounds, and wake up refreshed and motivated. It changed my whole routine for the better.

If you struggle to get up in the morning, stay asleep peacefully, or want to build a better routine, this is the app you need. It’s smart, effective, and even fun to use.

title: App perfecta para IOS y asutadizos
body:
Tras usar la app por mas de 2 años he llegado a la conclusión de que es muy buena ya que no siento q ninguna otra app pueda mejorar lo q ofrece esta. 

La aplicación es muy intuitiva y eficiente a la hora de establecer alarmas, ya que te deja incluso copiar alarmas o poner una alarma de forma más rápida. 

Por otro lado los tonos de alarma que incluyen en la versión gratuita son bastante malos pero quizá es más por gustos personales.

La razón por la que instale la app en mi primer teléfono IOS fue que la alarma de este sistema operativo es extremadamente simple y poco útil, además la razón principal fue que cuando la alarma suena para despertarte suena directamente al máximo nivel de volumen y eso me despertaba asustado, en cambio con esta app puedo decidir un intervalo de tiempo en el que la alarma suena desde un volumen bajo hasta el volumen máximo, porque ¿a quién le gusta despertarse nervioso?

title: ¿Perfecta? Casi.

Es efectiva, mucho. Es la app más útil que he encontrado del estilo hasta ahora. Por lo cual les felicito. Pero tiene errores y problemas graves:

- La aplicación chupa MUCHÍSIMA batería en segundo plano, consumiendo así antes los ciclos de batería del teléfono -afectando a la salud de tu dispositivo-.  Algo que me parece imperdonable.

- He pensado en adquirir la version premium, pero me parece un abuso pagar 7€/mes por lo que ofrece… estoy dispuesto a pagar MÁXIMO 2€/mes o hacer un pago único de 10€ -lo que vale de normal un despertador, vaya-.
Que sí, es muy útil, pero creo que 7€ es aprovecharse de un problema que tiene la gente a la hora de activarse por las mañanas. No me parece justo :(
Me temo que hasta que no lo modifiquen, no pagaré por una aplicación que me gustaría pagar y apoyar…

title: Perfecta.
body:
Leer reseñas de la gente que no puntúa bien a esta APP es de ser BOBOS.

1. Si la desinstalas OBVIAMENTE va a dejar de sonar. No se que pretende la gente… ¿que manden a un agente de la APP a tu cama y que te de tortazos hasta que te levantes? Pues eso. Que tienes 6 opciones gratuitas para que te levantes sí o sí  y si la borras, se supone que si tienes tiempo para borrarla ya estas despierto.

2. NO ES DE PAGO. Hay una opción que es de pago pero para lo que sirve, no hace falta pagar. Y obviamente hay opciones PREMIUM porque estas aplicaciones las hacen PERSONAS que comen y pagan hipotecas, como tú. Y ese trabajo se valora.

3. La sección noticias SÍ FUNCIONA BIEN, pero vamos, que esto no es El País o El Mundo. Sirve para que te entretengas algo. 

4. SI dejas el móvil en NO MOLESTAR, no te suena. No es difícil de entender que al no ser una APP de APPLE no hay otra forma.

Resumiendo, APP perfecta, te despiertas si o si y a no ser que la borres (como es lógico) sigue sonando y sonando.

P.D.: Usen la “LOUD SOUND 6” suena horrorosamente, se te mete el sonido en el tímpano y te despiertas o parece una tortura, QUE ES PARA LO QUE LA APP ESTÁ HECHA.

Aunque parezca un borde, no lo soy jajaja. Pero me fastidia ver comentarios desperdiciando el trabajo cuando no es así, y es una de las pocas APPS QUE SIN PAGAR dan lo que ofrecen. 

👍🏻😀

title: Great app but math section needs more options!
body:
The math puzzles you have to solve before the alarm ends is great, and you can choose both how many puzzles and how hard they are. You can see your math skills developing really fast, and it REALLY wakes you up!

The problem is that I can’t completely decide what kind of math puzzles I get. I would want to solve something like 63*48 etc., but I can’t get multiplication without addition so for example hard mode is XX*XX+XXX instead of just XX*XX. Please fix that so I can systematically choose which math skills to develop. 

Also choosing the range of numbers would be needed, like multiplication with numbers from 10 to 40 or whatever I choose to choose. Aaand it would make a LOT of sense to be able to do subtractions and divisions too.

This would improve the quality dramatically, and I’m sure that it would bring tons of new customers.

Other than that the app is great!

Btw it’s pretty funny that I could choose to have to solve NINETY-NINE puzzles in the form of XXX*XX+XXXX 😂 What a way to wake up every morning.

title: Très très très mitigé
body:
D’abord le positif : en tant qu’hypersomniaque, ça aide vraiment à sortir du lit et se réveiller vraiment, je prononce la phrase de vérification en servant mon café donc ça fonctionne. 

Mais maintenant le négatif, et là y’a du discutable.
Déjà le prix ! 30€ par AN pour un réveil ?????? Allo ??? Je trouve ça indécent, et oui certain me diront que la formule gratuite suffit, mais avoir des missions qui te font photographier un truc chez toi dans ton salon ça t’oblige à vraiment sortir du lit, donc c’est important, les missions gratuites m’ont toujours laissée me rendormir…
Un payement unique serait bien plus justifié, parce que la c’est de l’abus vraiment je vais arrêter mon abonnement je suis en précarité.

Ensuite autre GROS problème : on vous fait créer un compte pour sauvegarder vos données dans le cloud, c’est pas pour qu’en désinstallant et réinstallant l’application je perde TOUTES MES ALARMES !!!!?? Je n’en ai plus aucune je dois tout reconfigurer (ce qui est très long quand on a des problèmes de sommeil, y’a quasi une alarme toutes les 30 min). ET JE RAPPELLE QUE JE PAYE 30€ PAR AN HEIN, DE L’ABUS POUR UN SERVICE SI MÉDIOCRE, c’est ça qui m’as fait laissé cet avis maintenant. 

Je ne parle pas de la consommation ABUSIVE de batteries on parle de 100% à 0% dans la nuit si vous ne branchez pas.
Je ne parle pas non plus de leurs missions « trouver tel objet » chez vous qui doit bien sûr alimenter leur IA interne avec vos photos mais à la limite je m’en fou.

Honnêtement je pense que placer un simple réveil à 15€ dans votre salon vous sera bien plus bénéfique. Alarmy est une bonne aide à l’hypersomnie mais malheureusement ils sont bien trop avares.

title: Problème de batterie à fuir
body: Très déçu. Malgré la désactivation de l’actualisation en arrière-plan sur mon iPhone, Alarmy continue de fonctionner pendant des heures en arrière-plan. En une seule nuit, ma batterie est passée de 71 % à 28 %, soit 43 % de batterie consommés. Dans les réglages Batterie d’iOS, Alarmy est clairement identifié comme ayant tourné plus de 7 heures en arrière-plan. Une application de réveil ne devrait pas avoir un tel impact sur l’autonomie. J’espère qu’une mise à jour corrigera ce problème, car l’application est efficace pour les alarmes, mais cette consommation est inacceptable.

Since I uninstalled it, my battery does not die out after only 2 hours, but 2 weeks of use really took a toll on it.
If you could fix this issue it would be great. I don't know how the app is supposed to work.
Some people on the internet said that some apps of the sort will run the clips all day long on background, until it's time for the alarm to go off.

title: phénoménal
body:
J’ai un sommeil très lourd, et je suis insomniaque (un combo formidable, me direz-vous); j’ai donc tout essayé pour réussir à me réveiller : dormir par terre, laisser la fenêtre ouverte (même en hiver), laisser mon alarme dans une autre pièce… rien de tout ça n’a fonctionné, jusqu’à ce que j’essaye Alarmy ! Je suis maintenant levée dans les 20 minutes suivant la sonnerie, et, même si il m’arrive encore de me rendormir, je me lève maintenant huit fois sur 10 (au lieu des 2 fois sur 10 auxquels j’étais habituée). 
Ça fait 2 mois que j’utilise la fonction gratuite, et elle est très satisfaisante, mais je pense passer à la fonction payante (qui n’a pas l’air si onéreuse), afin d’avoir l’option « vérification de levé ».
Merci infiniment pour cette application, en tant qu’étudiante, elle m’a littéralement sauvée la vie !!

title: Le profit avant tout !
body:
Cette application, au début, était incroyable ! Elle permettait de faire énormément de choses sans forcément mettre la main au portefeuille. Quand je l’ai téléchargée la première fois, je ne sais même pas si les pubs existaient sur l’appli, pour vous dire. Mais maintenant, c’est un dégueulis de pubs…

Le moindre missclick t’envoie sur une pub, et ça, c’est agaçant à souhait !!
Vous profitez du fait qu’on ne soit pas complètement réveillés pour faire du profit là-dessus 👌🏽 Votre appli pue la pub à chaque clic, c’est à gerber !

Sans compter la consommation de batterie si on a le malheur de laisser l’application tourner en tâche de fond… Alors je sais pas ce que vous foutez en arrière-plan, mais expliquez-moi comment vous bouffez 40 % de batterie en à peine 5h ? C’est pas moi qui l’invente, c’est noté noir sur blanc dans le suivi de consommation de batterie dans les réglages Apple !
Vous minez de la crypto dans notre dos ? Expliquez-moi vraiment ?

Honnêtement, cette appli est devenue plus une source de frustration qu’autre chose. Je la dégage de mon téléphone et sans aucun regret !

title: C’était parfait, puis…
body:
Alarmy c’était le meilleur réveil parmi tout l’AppStore. LA chose qui faisait la différence : le mode photo. Où on doit prendre en photo un élément pour éteindre le réveil. C’est le seul qui t’oblige vraiment à te lever finalement, on peut gérer les autres réveils depuis son lit. Malin, efficace, si simple mais révolutionnaire : comme plein d’autres personnes, vous aviez changé mes matins !
Et puis un jour vous avez décidé de supprimer ce mode, LE meilleur mode de votre appli. Pourquoi ? À lire les avis, c’était le préféré de beaucoup de monde en plus ?
C’est un peu amère que j’ai désinstallé l’appli puisque les autres modes ne servent pas à grand chose pour moi. Vous aviez LA bonne idée, pourquoi l’avoir enlevée ??
Une fan déçue…

body:
I rarely leave a review. And this one is one of a kind. 
1. After 4 months of daily usage, the app did not ring (or bugged) at least a dozen time. Which is way, way too much for a ring alarm. Seing that the dev is still correcting bugs after 12 years is embarrassing. Especially at this price point. 
2. Since a week or two, the app now wants me to share my data to advertisers. And if I don’t accept, I can’t sign in. 
That’s it. Not only it’s illegal, but mean. I’ll report it to Apple and the CNIL.

title: Des bugs qui rendent l’application inutilisable
body:
Je ne rédige jamais d’avis mais cette fois cela vaut la peine. 
Je n’ai pas mis une étoile car j’utilise l’application  depuis un moment et tout se passait très bien. Alors 2 de bons et loyaux services ne valent pas une seule étoile mais aujourd’hui l’application n’en vaut pas plus de 2…
Les bugs sont INCESSANTS. Les mises à jour récentes ont rendu l’utilisation de l’application impossible. L’application lag lorsque j’essaie péniblement de dérouler le menu contenant les diverses alarmes, à tel point que la plupart du temps je ne peux même pas atteindre le réveil que je souhaite allumer. Dans ses bons jours, l’application ne permet même plus d’allumer les réveils. Depuis, j’ai recommencé à utiliser les réveils Apple. 
Je suis sincèrement embêtée car j’aimais beaucoup cette application et serais ravie de l’utiliser à nouveau car elle m’était vraiment très utile. Or, aujourd’hui, elle n’est plus opérationnelle, c’est dommage.

title: CETTE APPLICATION A TRANSFORMÉ MA VIE
body:
Comme je me couche souvent très tard je n’arrivais jamais à me réveiller le matin et j’éteignais le réveil puis je me rendormais…
Mais depuis à peu près 1mois, 1 mois et demi, je me réveille systématiquement à 6h du matin et je reste réveillé !
La technique c’est de laisser le téléphone hors du lit pour devoir se lever et personnellement je résous des calculs mentaux ce qui me force à me réveiller physiquement et mentalement et j’ai prit une sonnerie insupportable qui me pousse à résoudre les calculs le plus vite !

En résumé, je m’améliore en calculs mentaux, je me lève à 6h et donc je me couche avant minuit le soir, ça a transformé ma vie !

On dirait vraiment un faux avis tellement c’est positif mais ça a sincèrement transformé ma vie !!!

Au passage, se réveiller tôt le matin ça permet aussi d’être plus heureux, accomplie dans sa vie, personnellement j’ai plus d’appétit qu’avant comme je commence ma journée plus tôt et je peux aller à la salle de sport en me levant.

En bref cette application m’a permis de changer drastiquement de vue grâce au principe de cause à effet grâce à tous les bien fait qui vont avec.

JE RECOMMANDE À 5 Milliards de %

title: App parfaite. Rien à redire
body:
Fait ce qu’on lui demande c’est à dire sonner à une certaine heure.

J’ai toujours trouvé l’application de base de réveil d’iOS qui utilise le  volume du “ringer” assez confuse et plusieurs fois j’ai programmé des alarmes qui ont sonné en silencieux. Pas très efficace pour se réveiller...

Avec Alarmy, il n’y pas ce problème, quand on programme une alarme avec un volume, elle sonne avec ce volume. Point. En plus, cette app propose de nombreuses options intéressantes pour les alarmes.

Non, vraiment rien à redire, je trouve cette app est parfaite dans la mesure où elle fait ce que je lui demande sans bugs.

However, there’s one issue I’ve only recently noticed. It literally drains your battery even when the app is completely closed. It’s currently my number one battery-consuming app. From 6 AM to 6 PM, it used over 30% of my battery. That’s simply not normal.

I’d really like the developers to address this major issue.

title: Reliable alarms but awful battery usage.
body: I downloaded this app a couple of months ago to combat the awful Apple alarms that never seem to go off. It worked a treat and helps me wake up on time every single day and it also has a medication/habit alarm that goes off every night and has been amazing for keeping me on track with my meds. HOWEVER, recently I noticed that my phone kept dying in the middle of the night despite it being on around 80% battery before I went to sleep. It happened frequently enough that I checked my battery usage in my settings and was surprised to see that the app is using up to 50% of my battery every charge when my phone isn’t even on nor is the app even open. I’ve had to delete it for this reason. So just watch out for that, the premise of the alarms becomes absolutely useless when your phone dies before the alarm even gets a chance to go off…

title: Amazing for ADHD
body:
Genuinely love this app, I recommend it to everyone. It is such a life saver for those with ADHD, it gives me so much peace of mind knowing that it WILL ring and it WILL wake me up, especially on important days like those with exams. 

If you struggle to get out of bed, this is the solution. You can choose any sound, a gentle sound like birdsong or something loud, you can make it increase in volume gradually, you can choose to add in snoozes, and most importantly- you can make it so the only way to turn it off is to scan a specific barcode. So what I do is use the barcode of my toothpaste, that way I HAVE to physically get up and go to the bathroom to scan it to turn off the alarm. 

Genuinely really appreciate this app, it’s helped me so much.

title: Doesn’t open
body:
Been using Alarmy for months now, I first got it because the apple Clock app kept being silent (I think I was phasing the alarm out for so long that it just started turning quiet after a while) and this one made sure I gave it my attention before it would finally shut up. A lot of the times I completed the tasks and just went back to sleep but.. that’s my own fault. I can also bypass the alarm by just powering my phone off which I learned very early on but I don’t expect the app to have something override that lol. 
But my main reason for this review was to say that I can no longer open the app. It’s stuck on the screen with the logo on. I tried deleting and downloading the app twice but every time I pressed ‘ask app not to track’ the app froze. If I opened another app or swiped it away, the frozen screen would be gone and I’d just be back on the screen with the logo. Anyway, there’s very similar apps so I’ll move on but it’s too bad, I got used to how this one works and I don’t think they could improve in any way (because it’s so perfect) besides fixing this one issue. But unless you face this same problem then I definitely recommend this app!

title: Amazing!
body:
This app is truly amazing for people who struggle to get up in the morning. 
I can wake up to an alarm but I will hit snooze over and over again refusing to actually get up!
Alarmy has changed this, I have never paid for a thing on it and it wakes me up every morning with a task that actually wakes up my brain! (My favourite is the item hunt but if you're not a fan of ai, the others are great - the item hunt just forces you to actually get out of bed).
This app has made me go from someone who wakes up 15 minutes before leaving for school and at 11:30am on weekends, to someone who wakes up 2 hours before having to leave the house and at 8:30am on weekends! 
It's phenomenal!! 
100% recommend.
(Also.. the "Grieg - Morning Mood" music is the best because it's not a song you'll get sick of, and it really makes you feel like you're waking up on a sunny morning.)

title: Expensive, invasive and Immoral
body:
I paid £49.99 (about $70) to use this app for a year to access all the features.

It is full of typos, especially with the spelling alarm tasks, a bit annoying but reasonable. From what I understand it’s a Chinese company so it doesn’t matter so much.

Despite paying so much for this app however, they started to run ads to access all features. Really annoying but manageable as a lot of the features I don’t use.

The really annoying thing however, is that they constantly update their terms of service to try to get you to give them greater access to your information a devices.

The final straw was in their most recent ToS update, you cannot sign in unless you give them access to EVERYTHING including facial ID.

TLDR; I cannot use the account I paid for without giving them access to EVERYTHING on my phone as they keep updating terms of service.

body: I can sleep through absolutely anything, it could be the end of the world and it wouldn’t wake me up. So I tried Alarmy thinking, it might work but I was sceptical. title: This app actually gets me up!
body: I have ADHD and for the longest time procrastination about getting out of bed made life such a struggle, and I was always pressing snooze on the default apple alarm while half asleep and making myself late. But I love this app because you can set different tasks, my favourite one is the barcode because then I have to get out of bed to scan my mouthwash. You can also set how many snoozes you get and how long they snooze for, which I find so useful. And it’s nice how you need to pay for everything, it’s refreshing having an app that’s actually useable. The only thing I would want added is being able to import your own alarm sounds, because I don’t love the selection they have. But you can still record your own voice recording for sound, which is nice but I want to be able to import an audio from your videos and set that as the alarm. Other than that, it’s great!

title: Decent but scummy
body:
App does what it says, it's an alarm app. But it's making me really want to invest in a physical alarm clock.

- Ads placed in inconvenient places, easy to press by mistake (even if seemingly out of the way).
- A lot of paywalled features, although I am personally completely fine with this; in most cases.
- Premium plans offering misleading discounts. 1 year is £59.88, a *discount* of 78% is offered.... for £19.99. Which is only 67% off (rounding up).
- Not sure on the experience of other apps since I've only used this, but Alarmy requires to be left open to work, which I'm not a fan of. Apple's Clock alarms works with the app being force closed.

I have no doubt this app is collecting and selling my data. But that's something I can only speculate on.

Just invest in a physical alarm clock if you can afford it 🤦‍♂️

title: Life changing
body:
It’s a Brilliant app folks, where do I start? 

Notifies you everytime you mindlessly remove its window to remind you that it can’t ring when closed. 

Send you multiple notifications as a backup plan if you accidentally have the app closed and an alarm set. 

You can choose many different ringtones and even create your own, and you can set your background. 

They have a fun challenge where if your try to bypass the alarm by shutting it down instead of completing your mission you have a penalty where a small amount of money is taken, 🤣 a voluntary though feature though

Wide range of mission with the a possibility of choosing the difficulty mode. 

Checks in on you after some time to see if you actually did wake up

Measures your snoring! Has background noise available for people who need noises to sleep (nature sound rain etc)

Measures you sleeping quality 

And more! I am probably missing things but I truly love this app so much, I never miss an alarm now. And the ringtones are gradual and gentle and not as jarring. 

Keep up the good work!

title: Invasive and annoying
body:

It has very invasive data usage on idle, doesn’t work without notifications but then doesn’t allow you turn off the awful spammy notifications that it sends you. And it spams you with invasive pop ups in the app constantly. Which wouldn’t bother me if there was a perpetual purchase option. But an AaaS (alarm as a service) is a bit too dystopian for me.

Gets an extra star for actually functioning as a decent alarm, but overall is an app with scummy practices everywhere. Glad it’s made me realise that an old fashioned desk alarm is superior still.

title: This app has saved my life
body:
I never write reviews but after I downloaded this app on a whim I was so pleasantly surprised that I feel I have to. At first, when I saw there was a paid option, I thought the free version would be purposefully lacking to entice you to pay. But I am loving it! You can set different tasks to do (I personally go for the maths tasks as I feel that wakes me up more). Not only that, but you can set the difficulty so it’s more personalised to you. This has been so effective in waking me up in the morning. It’s not easy to turn the alarm off so by the time you’ve done the 3 puzzles you’re almost wide awake (almost.. which is close enough for a 6am wake up). I was very happy to see that you can track your sleep on the free version as well. I find this keeps me accountable - once I’ve started tracking it, I feel I can’t go on my phone afterwards and fall asleep way quicker. It gives you an option for mindful sounds but I stick to a specific relaxing music playlist on YouTube. 

If you struggle going to sleep or waking up early then please please try this app! I will definitely be using this for a long time.

author: davedave826

title: ‘Woke’ me when I had been up for ages!
body:
I thought this alarm app looked great. In theory it has a lot going for it, which is why I gave it a second star. But twice in 6 days it has ‘woken’ me when I’ve been up for a long time. I was trying it for the unique way it’s meant to wake you. I can get all the other benefits from other apps I already have. So there’s no point my paying for an app that fails one third of the time.

In response to the developer’s reply, yes, I had done everything you tell us to do. I don’t complain about something before absolutely following all the instructions. On the occasions when it went off when I was up, I was actually using my phone at the time, and that meant I was no longer obeying the instructions. I assumed that it wasn’t going to go off that morning, because of that! You have a great many negative reviews (as well as lots of positive ones) so I think you need to make the trial period a month in order to have time to help the people for whom this app doesn’t work. You’ve had people late for work, late for appointments, fired, and I’m sure there must have been other complaints (there are too many to read) because Alarmy didn’t work for them, so you need to do something proactive to help people before the end of their trial period, or your business won’t thrive. I don’t have time to fiddle with it any more, and I’m sure I’m not the only one. I’m certainly not going to pay for it, as it takes too long to get help.

title: Used to be amazing…
body:
This app used to be the good standard of waking up tech. The barcode scanner alarm, the assuredly loud notifications telling you what the current time is if you’re ignoring the alarm, everything. Sadly it has dropped massively dropped off. 
I stopped using it for however many months and have come back to find two major problems: 
1. A prohibitively expensive subscription for features that I’d previously bought outright and thought I had for life.
2. The app doesn’t work! The alarm has failed on me twice. The only purpose of this app was its reliability and making sure that you were awake. If it can’t do this then it’s just a stupid game.

People have said that you need to open the app before you go to bed to ensure it works. That’s ludicrous. It never used to be this way. As someone who struggles to get out of bed and had thought had found a solution to that issue, I’m not adding an extra part to my routine just for me to have a better chance at waking up on time!

All in all it seems that Alarmy’s developers are milking what used to be a great app. Save your money and go elsewhere.

title: Doesn’t work properly!
body:
I never usually write reviews for apps but this app annoyed me so much, I just had to write one. 

The app is good when it actually works, sadly though, it doesn’t work 100% of the time. 

Firstly I started out using the ‘shake’ alarm. About once a week this feature just wouldn’t work. I’d be shaking the phone the exact same way as the other days (which worked before), but it just wouldn’t count any shakes. And of course the alarm doesn’t stop going off until you’ve finished! So I would have to reset my whole phone in order to turn it off.

Then I started using the maths alarm which was better for a while. Then with the new iOS updates, I started having problems with that too. 

The app started draining about 50-60% on my battery every day!! They tell you to close the app in the background to save battery. Problem is, you have to remember to reopen the app every night or it won’t ring in the morning. There were a few times I forgot to reopen the app, then no alarm rang in the morning and I overslept.

This week it just hasn’t worked at all even though I’ve been reopening the app every night. I keep my phone on silent by default, but looks like this app won’t ring at all now if my phones on silent? I need to keep it on silent during the night so notifications aren’t waking me up, so this app is useless now.

title: Alarmy is my lifesaver
body:
After years - literally years - of not being able to wake up on time, Alarmy has come to my rescue. I am an incredibly deep sleeper, and waking up has always been extremely difficult for me. I often slept through alarms, or would be so groggy in the morning that I would turn off my alarm without a second thought and oversleep; essentially, I consistently overslept and was late all the time for university and work or even missed them completely. At one point I even had five physical alarm clocks in my bedroom to try and wake me, but all that would happen was I would wake up furious at the noise, get up, turn them off and go back to sleep. 

Alarmy changed all that with its thoughtful features, that effectively tackle each of these issues. The sound and volume options cut through my sleep but not in a way that makes me want to punch someone, and I like the range of options of activities by which to turn off the alarm, as it caters for different people’s preferences. My personal favourite is the squatting option, as it forces me out of my bed for an extended period of time and wakes me up more than staring at my phone. I also really love the wake-up check because of my habit of going back to sleep. 

This alarm is the only one that has ever worked consistently for me and I’m not exaggerating when I say that this app has changed my life. I cannot sing its praises highly enough. Thank you Alarmy!! Here’s to many more years of waking up on time☺️

body:
Firstly, I just want to say this app is fantastic. However, this review is related to the pricing. 

I purchased ‘Alarmy Pro.’ - using this app does not allow me to restore purchases for this and insists I must pay the subscription which is a LUDICROUS £7.49 per month - or £59.99 a year. £60 a year for an alarm clock. It’s not even a one-time purchase. 

I wouldn’t be so bitter, had I not originally purchased the Pro version. This specific app is now no longer available on the App Store, so I would have to subscribe if I wanted the features back. 

Terrible model, and so expensive. How can they justify £7.49 per month? There is minimal data, servers etc - there are streaming services for a lower cost than this, which have huge datacentres, opsec, licences and more. Absolutely insane. If this issue is not able to be resolved I refuse to pay this and will invest in a good physical alarm clock. If it is, however, I will amend this review accordingly.

title: Alarmy: how it made my gpa drop
body: Imagine this. It’s Tuesday morning, you have a 9:30 class that you slept through for the fourth time this semester. You didn’t even hear your alarm go off for a whole hour. So you hunt around for an app that is going to do more than just make a noise you can easily switch off in your sleep, then you stumble across this. It seems perfect with all its extra features and cool sounds, so you try it out. You set it up to make you do some math problems while a rooster obnoxiously yells through your phone, but because this is new and you don’t trust it to work yet you set an extra alarm. Fast forward to Wednesday morning, you wake up not to the rooster but the ear scorching apple alarm tone. You pick up your phone and apparently the alarm has gone off because you are still forced to solve some middle school level math problems. At this point you decide it’s much too early for the gym anyway, so you set another alarm (an Apple alarm) and go back to sleep. Now, fast forward to Wednesday evening, the night before the day of the class you just missed. You set up the Alarmy again. This time with the shake feature and a much more startling alarm tone. You decide that since the only issue with Alarmy last time was the volume it would be okay to not set another alarm and just make sure your volume and ringer is turned all the way up. You wake up, not to an alarm sound but just because your body decided it was time. You think you’ve woken up earlier than your alarm and feel proud of this near impossible feat. Then you check your phone. It’s 9:50. Where the **** was this all amazing alarm?? Did you not hear it? Was the sound too low again? No. At night your phone is set to be on Do Not Disturb until 10am. It has been like this for years and never stopped your normal alarm, but this was Alarmy, and apparently Alarmy doesn’t work through the barrier of Do not Disturb, but it also doesn’t warn you of this discrepancy. So there you are, already 20 minutes late for a class you have missed now over 5 times. This is a small liberal arts college where participation MATTERS. Your grade is now going to drop. Although I feel Alarmy isn’t entirely to blame I must confess that I am a petty person, and in my eyes my falling gpa is going to be entirely attributed to this app. Please beware and DO NOT TRUST IT.

title: This App is Genius!!!!!
body:
My friend recommended this app as I have no diagnosis but I would sleep in and sleep through alarms. Some days sleep through a whole day. I would struggle to be punctual to work and meetings. I also suffer from severe depression and anxiety, so my energy levels are random. I get a lot of insomnia, basically my life felt like utter chaos and mess, with absolute no structure. Health wise I feel a lot of tiredness and I feel sleepy and weak most of the time. 

When I tried this app, it’s so genius because especially the steps which make you complete a number of steps before it would leave you alone and stop the alarm. I implemented a combo of writing motivational phrases a couple times, which allows me to open my eyes trying to complete the writing exercises correctly. Then another alarm 5 minuets later with a steps exercise. (So that allows me to get up to the bathroom to wash my face or even make my smoothie). And as a bonus added the voice reading out the time and date and a voice giving me a push (like a parent would when you were a child). 

Let me tell you I completed many productive days and felt like I was achieving more out of my days. I was becoming very punctual and it really is changing my life in a drastic way. 

I am amazed it is helping me shape a productive and structured life. 

All I can say is thank you thank thank you!!!!!

Keep up the good work and may you get blessings your way for creating such a genius app.

Especially when you live in cold and gloomy weather conditions you really want to stay cosy in your bed. So this App allows you get out of bed and exercise your mind. There is so many genius methods to wake you up and get out of a deep sleeping mode. (Especially if you are a deep sleeper like me, some people call me a sloth hahahaha) 

Let me tell you it will not stop, there is literally no way to stop it unless you complete the amount of steps you set. And write the phrases word by word without a mistake. I can go on.

I also love the melody it’s so refreshing.

If you haven’t yet try this App out!!!!! 

It can change many peoples life. 

Great job!!!

title: Checkmate
body:
Game changer. Checkmated myself. I’m working on self development (aren’t we all) and since I’ve moved back home after finishing uni, I’ve been struggling to get into a proper routine like I used to, where I’d wake up at 7am every day to get my day started. But now even when I’d sleep on time allowing a generous 7/8 hours sleep, I could not, for the life of me, get myself out of bed until a 3/4 hours after 7am at the earliest. It started to annoy me, seriously, because I’d done it before so why can’t I do it now. 

I then came across Alarmy on a Reddit post and instantly knew this app is what I need. I use the barcode mission. I kept the barcode in my car which is usually parked a minute or two from my house. So I have no choice but to get OUT of bed, put on a top, grab my keys, put on some sliders and then walk into fresh air. Like I said, checkmated myself. I’ve only had this app for one day but it’s a game changer and I’m excited to see my progress.

title: The only way to make me get out of bed...
body:
I found Alarmy through Instagram, and it has, quite literally, changed my life. I always used to set several alarms to ensure I wake up on time, and even then I’d sleep through them or snooze them. With Alarmy, I’m forced out of bed to switch it off (I use the barcode option to switch the alarm off!), and the actual alarm (I use the Rooster sound) is so loud that it jerks me awake! 
I use it to make sure I get up at a good, productive time; and also to plan my day and get as much done as possible. 

The only thing I could think of to improve the app is to allow the alarms to be organised in ways to suit the user (and it would be fantastic if this option could be in the free app). For example, I’d love to be able to set them up in day order, rather than the time order they’re set in. I have so many alarms due to my varied lifestyle, and it can take quite a while to find the one I want to edit!

body: When I first downloaded this I thought it was amazing, the features were great and it got me out of bed in the morning. The app has become my motivation of getting off the bed everyday. I can wake up on time and make a great breakfast to start the date.

title: Slowly changing my life
body:
After seeing this on someone’s morning routine I downloaded this and have been using it for the last 2 weeks to help implement regular wake up times. I have CFS/ME (classed as ‘mild’) and this has made such a huge difference! Before, I would have sooo many alarms and totally overuse the snooze button which, even tho I crave sleep, was making me feel so much worse. Now, i set my radio to come on 30 mins before I need to get up, then an alarm on this app to get me out of bed at just the right time. It’s fab!!! No more snooze button!! This app forces me to get up and walk to the other end of the house to turn the alarm off and is really helping correct my body clock and sleep routine. I never thought I would say this but I genuinely look forward to mornings now. Hopefully the good progress continues. 
Suggestion: perhaps an the option to ‘lock’ an alarm for, say, the 30 mins before it’s due to go off, with the same requirement to ‘unlock’ and then amend/delete it as it would be to turn it off (ie barcode, quiz etc). So, if you do wake up early, you’re not able to turn the alarm off without doing the same exercise, therefore not allowing you to stay in bed! Hope that makes sense. Keep up the great work either way, just casually improving lives over there!

title: Gamechanger
body:
This app has changed my life. The best mission for me is the barcode one. It's so clever! You take a picture of anything with a barcode on it, then to turn the alarm off in the morning you have to take a picture of the same barcode. So I use milk cartons in my kitchen meaning it forces me out of bed and into the kitchen to turn the alarm off, by which point I have the milk in my hand and think 'well I might as well make a tea' and then I'm awake!

I actually started using this app as a punishment. I set a normal iPhone alarm a few minutes before this one is set to go off, so then I know if I don't get up that I'll be forced to by the super loud and annoying sound that this one makes (which is a good thing! There are also less annoying sounds available).

The only 'downside' is that you can delete the app to shut it up, but this isn't the app's fault as there's no way around that. I only discovered this when my housemate threw out the milk carton before I'd got up so I couldn't turn it off any other way 😂

title: Very good alarm app but I have a suggestion
body:
I’ve been using this app for a while now: according to the app, 249 days as of today. This is one of the best alarm clock apps you’ll come across, as it was the case for me. I’m a heavy sleeper. So heavy that if I don’t have activities to turn alarms off in the morning such as the maths one or the one where you shake the phone, I would probably turn it off in my sleep. 

Just a suggestion: I don’t have a fixed time when waking up, it changes between a range of half an hour from one another, depending on how tired I am and how late I sleep. So changing the time for the alarm every night can get really tedious, especially if you need several alarms to wake up like I do. It would be really cool if there was a quicker way to input the times instead of scrolling through the dial thing. Maybe have an option to type in the numbers. Or have a analogue watch interface where you tap on the numbers on the watch face depending on the time you want to wake up to. This would make my bedtime process so much quicker and I would really appreciate if this was the case!

title: BEST ALARM APP EVER!
body:
I’m a student so therefore I have to wake up at 6AM every morning and it’s sometimes hard to get out of bed so I end up being late to school 😭 Alarmy has LITERALLY changed my life! 
- I love the whole set up of the app as it’s very minimal, simple and calming. 
- It’s so incredibly easy so use!
- I really like how the app tells you how long until you alarm rings as it gives me a idea of how many hours I’ll be sleeping.
- I especially love their sleep music (my favourite is the light rain) as they are all very calming.
- The actual alarm sounds that they have are amazing! I really do believe that what you wake up to can set your mood for the day so the fact that Alarmy has different sounds for different sleepers is really amazing. I personally am a very deep sleeper who doesn’t need a crazy loud alarm but something noticeable so I love to use ‘Sunshine’ as it’s very light, happy and calming.
- The missions Alarmy uses are really cool as they really do get me out of bed! For school days I like to set 2-3 rounds of hard maths questions to get my brain going but on more relaxed days I’ll do a few easy roads of the memory games.
MY ONLY complaint is that I can’t figure out how to make Alarmy ‘run in the background’ of my phone as I switch my phone onto silent at night and the alarm does not sound??!!
Overall an amazing app and would definitely recommend 💘

So when it goes off in the morning - (the alarm is so loud all I want to do is stop it ASAP) I have to scan a certain barcode before it stops (picked an item I keep on my shelf so physically have to get out of bed to stop it) 
Honestly it’s awful, but an intervention was needed and now I’m up on my first alarm.

The “Quick Alarm” function is very useful, especially when you have little time to add a reminder note & need a quick alarm setting up, only takes 2-3 secs to create

If I could suggest a practical improvement to the designer, .... perhaps look at adding a “search tool” which other alarm apps include, to enable users to search /locate previous alarms (reminders) & quickly reset them or delete them. 

No one likes redesigning the wheel so if you can search & home-in on older alarms & tweak/reset them, this would save users a lot of time

In the current version you can’t. 
It requires you to scroll thro a long list of reminder alarms to find anything

A “search tool” would solve this problem

If the app had a search engine tool, I would it 5 ⭐️👍

title: Amazing, but one little suggestion!
body:
When my usual alarm goes off in the morning, I don’t ‘wake up’ - instead, a primitive part of my brain who’s soul purpose is to ensure I get the longest sleep possible is engaged and has resulted in many a missed event or meeting.

Alarmy has completely changed my life.

I chose the barcode option and used a barcode from my kitchen, by the time I’ve walked down the stairs and disabled the ringer I am fully in control of my faculties and ready to start the day! Instantly, I am now a proper adult.

 I have one little suggestion to the app developers that I think would make this app even better. Unfortunately ‘sleepy me’ is very crafty and the second time I used this app, I figured out I could just delete it to silence the alarm and return to snoozeland. I’ve had my partner set a restrictions passcode on my iPhone that prevents me from deleting any apps, so there is a way to circumvent this issues - BUT, it would be amazing if it could be set up that you can only delete this app when the alarm is not in progress as it’s a bit inconvenient having to wait till the end of the day to have my partner take away the restriction if I want to delete one of my app. I understand Apple may have restricted the power to do this though, hence why I have still reviewed with a deserved 5 stars rather than 4 to show its amazing but could be better with a little change! title: Best alarm clock I've ever used
body:
I loved my old alarm app because it trapped my sleep, which was fine for someone with no mornings, but I've recently had to change that and the other one was letting me down (let me snooze longer if I had a "poor" sleep and I'd be late!). 
 I wasn't expecting much from an alarm app, but this one is everything I didn't even know I wanted. There is loads of options to choose from in regards to how you want to wake up (maths, puzzle, scan etc.) and you can turn off snooze (horrible but necessary!).
 I chose maths as I'm awful at it so I have to really think! Four questions and by the second my brain is switching on and by the fourth I'm alert and fully awake. 
There are also lots of options for alarm sounds AND a sleep noise option with a timer (amazing and so unexpected). It even tells you your horoscope and the weather and news.
It's early days yet but first impressions using it for 3 days is I wish I would have tried this sooner. My other app is great for days off but this is the real deal for if you are like me and have the best intentions but morning you has totally different ideas!

title: Saved my life !!!
body:
This app is the best alarm I've ever had !! I'm totally not a morning person, and I'm late for work around 80% of the time. Whenever I'm on time, my workmates clap and cheer me😂😂😂! 
My manager keeps having words with me about my time keeping and I've had the feeling that sooner or later I'd probable get the sack,
aaaaahhhh !!
I love my job, but I can never get up on time, so I started searching for a new alarm that can physically get me out of bed. 
I thought I'd have to recreate a wallace and gromit style alarm clock that tips my bed up, I'd already tried putting my electric blanket on a plug timer and setting it to go on at stupid o'clock in the morning to sweat me out of bed, but the plug timer went wrong a few times and ended up getting really hot at around 2:45am, took ages to cool down too ! 
But then I came across Alarmy, and it has changed my life !!
I'd chosen to do the photo one where you take a picture of something in another room or down stairs, then when Alarmy goes off you have to match the photo up with the thing you took the picture of, then the alarm stops. Genius !!
It was a mistake taking a picture of my cat the first time I used it though !
Alarmy physically gets me out of bed every morning and I've been on time everyday for a whole week, and it feels amazing 😄! I don't feel stressed and guilty every day I go to work, it makes me feel very calm and happy to be leaving my house on time every morning xx
It still kills me getting up at 5:30am 5 days a week, and I'll never be a morning person, but this app has definitely changed my life !xxxx
Why the hell is it free ?? You could make loads out of this !!

title: Persistent Drain: Isolated to Background Network Activity
body:
Updating my review following developer correspondence. Recommending users plug in overnight doesn't address the software issue causing 30% battery drops on an iPhone 15 (91% health).
A key finding for the dev team: the drain is tied directly to network activity.
 When tested with Wi-Fi and mobile data active, battery plummets from ~70% to 40% overnight.
 When tested completely offline (Wi-Fi and mobile data toggled off), the battery drain is drastically reduced.
While still higher than ideal, the stark difference indicates relentless background data calls or telemetry loops while idle. Please look into why the app is generating so much background data traffic overnight when it should be idle.

body:
Ive been a alarmy user for more than 3 years. I love this app. Just recently i found some flaws that made me uninstall. 
1. The app has to be running in the background. Its obvious. But when the phone goes to low power mode. It automatically disables all the apps background refresh. As a result the alarm wont go off in the morning if your phone is in low power mode

2. It is not a light app. It consumes a lot of battery in the background. In my case the most is 22% just in one night. 

3. Very limited ringtones when there is no internet. I mean. I am someone who turns off the internet at night. 

Other than that. The missions and alarm sound are spot on

title: Found a Bug!
body:
I genuinely love Alarmy. I’ve been using it for a long time now, and it has helped me a lot with waking up on time. I’ve even recommended it to a few friends because it really works. Huge appreciation to the team for building such a useful app.

However, I’ve noticed a loophole that’s affecting its purpose (at least for me). Even when the snooze limit is set (for example, 2 snoozes), if I force-close the app while the alarm is ringing and then reopen it, the alarm starts ringing again — but the snooze count gets reset. This allows me to snooze again, even though I had already used up my allowed snoozes.

Unfortunately, I’ve subconsciously started using this trick and end up sleeping longer, which defeats the whole point of the app 😅

I really hope the team can fix this issue, because Alarmy works best when it’s strict. Thank you so much for your efforts and for an otherwise amazing app!

title: Varun ravi
body:
Personally I love the app.
Until today 
When I got a what looked like pretty standard data consent ad message.
I was about to say ok when I started reading and saw how much of data and lack of privacy the app would make me have if I blindly agreed.
It would take data from other apps and my device storage, access my precise geolocation and then in turn share this and more with its partners; sounds small but these partners are over 1000 of them. 
Fortunately there Is a way to turn off this but not many people ( almost nobody) clicks the learn more ever ! ( where I was able to disable everything)
And so they try to use this to blindly rob people of their data. 
I still use the app cause the app itself is good but please everyone who uses this app disable the data collection right away !

body:
I know and used this application for years now, and I have absolutely nothing to say about its functionality because it’s absolutely great.

But there is a huge huge huge problem with it, it absolutely drains your phone’s battery in a way that it’s absolutely not normal. I see my iPhone 16 pro battery (which normally lasts until night with no need to charge during the day) going completely down when I have this app downloaded and I use it. I think the major issue comes from its background activity, it literally cuts in half how much my battery lasts. This problem should be solved otherwise the application is completely unusable.

title: Facile da usare e Soddisfacente
body:
L’app é piacevolmente intuibile, facile e molto carina.
Quello che cercavo: quando imposto una sveglia Alarmy mi comunica quante ore e minuti di sonno avrò fino al risveglio. 

Certamente non ci vuole tanto a calcolare le ore in semplice autonomia,,ma essendo ben abituata da una decade con Samsung ,che mi dava questa possibilità, ora che ho cambiato ad IPhone mi scocciava molto non avere più quella comunicazione tanto comoda quanto GRADITA a cui ero abituata da 10 anni con Samsung!!! 

Non capisco perché IPhone non abbia questa semplice possibilità, penso che ci voglia poco ad implementare questa forma di comunicazione che sinceramente MANCA.
Anche se risulterò  esagerata, e apprezzo questa app, avrei preferito non dover scaricare un’altra app sveglia perché insoddisfatta dall’app del telefono IPhone.

title: Buona ma migliorabile
body:
Ottimo allarme molto personalizzabile, permette di programmare la sveglia in maniera facile e rapida, però secondo me ha alcuni punti critici da risolvere:
1. Nel volume della sveglia in crescendo sarebbe ottimo avere anche 2 e 3 minuti. Attualmente lo step passa da 1 minuto a 5 minuti. Io ho messo i 5 minuti ma sono un po’ lunghi e 1 minuto è troppo poco.
2. Non capisco perché pur pagando Apple Music sarei obbligato a comprare le stesse canzoni che ho già a disposizione su iTunes, nella sveglia di default del mio iPhone ho tutte le canzoni della mia playlist a mia completa disposizione da usare anche come suoneria della sveglia.
3. Ultima pecca almeno per me insormontabile è deve per forza rimanere attiva in background, diversamente partono mille notifiche che non si possono disattivare. 
4. Nel caso i tre punti sopra vengano risolti sarebbe bello avere tra le opzioni di acquisto di questa app il pagamento per togliere la pubblicità in maniera permanente

Ho messo tre stelle perché ha un enorme difetto, non è possibile che quando la lascio in background e mi sveglio la mattina successiva, mi ritrovo il livello della batteria diminuito del 20-30% con risparmio energetico, il mio iPhone 8 non ha nessun problema o componenti danneggiate.

title: Ottima
body: L’allarme è ben funzionante. Funziona in tutte le condizioni, a patto che non sia chiusa dal background la notte. L’Allarme non si disattiva finché non si compie ciò che si è scelto in fase di set; neanche chiudendola in background perché questa si riapre, facendo apparire la notifica. L’unica soluzione è quella di disinstallare l’app. Ottima la sezione notizie e meteo dopo aver disattivato la sveglia così come anche le modalità di disattivazione (cuore dell’app). Tutte le modalità sono abbastanza pratiche e funzionanti. Anche le tracce audio sono ben fatte e ben studiato è il timer affinché si disattivino. Personalmente l’ho sostituita all’app orologio di iPhone. C’è anche il tempo che passa prima che suoni la sveglia (tempo in cui si dorme - per me molto utile). Rivedrei solo la grafica, tenendola più stile iOS nella attivazione dell’allarme. Rivedrei anche l’icona molto simile a quella di Instagram per colori. Ho acquistato l’app anche se la pubblicità non è invasiva. Ben fatta. Un applauso agli sviluppatori!

title: Tiene muchos fallos
body:
En muchas ocasiones la alarma no suena y sin motivo, he procurado tener la app en segundo plano pues es muy importante para mí que me despierte y aún así no suena. Además los domingos nunca suena desconozco la razón . Tampoco está el modo silencio ni se empalma con otra alarma, simplemente funciona cuando quiere.

Al poner la opción de la foto, si por algún motivo no tienes la foto a la mano por viajar o cambiaste un objeto de lugar la única manera de desactivar la alarma es apagando el celular o borrando la app. El sonido de la alarma frecuentemente se bugea, suena una canción que no he elegido y un nivel muy alto, incluso aunque haya puesto el volumen a un nivel medio, lo peor es que deja el volumen así de alto y si llego a ver video o a poner música suena fuertisimo. 

Finalmente cabe mencionar que los de Alarmy no hacen nada al respecto, sacan y sacan nuevas funciones pero no arreglan lo que ya está ¿De qué sirve una mascota si la app no me va a despertar?

title: Solved the advertised problem
body:
Of course proper sleep is the main measure to get up when you should, but I used to take like 30 minutes to an hour to get up on bad days despite having a couple dozen regular alarms set. With this app I usually get up immediately, and within 15 minutes at most otherwise. The app offers many features but I just use the basic "force me to shake the phone to stop the alarm". I don't like ads but at least this app's aren't that intrusive.
As for feedback, I wish they had more "normal" usable ringtones. As of writing there's only one ("Orkney"). Also wish I wasn't dumped into the "Morning" tab after the alarm is turned off, for which I have no use.

title: Buena pero con detalles
body:
Es una muy buena aplicación, pero la cantidad de batería que consume es irreal (25% diario aprox) y no se puede cerrar durante las noches ya que al cerrarla ya no hay alarma, sugieren dentro de la app dejar conectado tu celular durante la noche para garantizar al 100% tu alarma, algo que es peligroso.

En mi punto de vista al menos, es molesto el hecho de que la alarma siga sonando durante la misión, la misión se hace con el objetivo de mantenerse despierto posterior a abrir los ojos cosa que es función del sonido, entiendo que hay gente que prefiere esto por lo que añadiría la opción de quitar sonido durante la misión.

Dejando a un lado estos dos detalles es una buena app, no hay forma de que te quedes dormido y tiene detalles muy buenos.

Recomendaciones: Tener 100% de batería antes de ir a dormir, no usarla si tienes un/a compañer@ de habitación que se despierte en otro horario, es molesto que siga sonando durante las misiones, usar el preview de las alarmas, ya que en algunos dispositivos el sonido si es demasiado fuerte.

Le daría personalmente un 7/10 pero si añadieran esa opción de que no haya sonido durante la misión seria un 9.5/10 entiendo que no es sencillo el tema del consumo de batería por eso no tiene tanta ponderación en mi calificación.

title: Por qué la suscripción??????
body:
Empecé a usar Alarmy porque me costaba mucho trabajo despertar, y resolver puzzles me ayudó bastante.
Alarmy cumple con lo que promete, una alarma con puzzles. Pero, tiene mucho potencial la aplicación. Lo malo es que para aprovechar eso tienes que pagar, y no le veo sentido a pagar por una alarma…
Al día que escribí esto, la aplicación tiene restricciones y pagar quitarlas tienes que pagar una suscripción mensual de $105 al mes. Lo cual se me hace ridículamente elevado.
No me molestaría pagar una pequeña suma por una aplicación, de un solo pago. Si esta aplicación fuera la versión “lite” como en el 2009, y existiera la aplicación full, que costara, pero fuera de un solo pago, sin problemas pagaría por eso. No entiendo la necesidad de hacer todo de suscripción. 
La aplicación cumple con lo que promete, pero si encuentras lo mismo, en una versión gratis y sin suscripción, descarga esa otra versión.

Esta muy bien, esta la alarma y tiene diferentes modos de apagarla ya sea agitandola, con ecuaciones, etc. Tu puedes elegir cuál.
También hay una sección donde hay música para dormir y puedes poner cuanto tiempo quieres que esté para que tu teléfono no se quede encendido toda la noche.
Finalmente hay una sección donde puedes ver tu horoscopo, clima y diferentes noticias de tu país o mundial.
En fin, todo el gratis y esta muy bien.. MUY COMPLETA.

title: Te despierta si o si

La aplicación va excelente. Cuando usaba mi Apple Watch y llegaba la hora de sonar la alarma, en vez de sonar, solo enviaba notificaciones al reloj y no se escuchaba en el celular, lo cual era un problema. Sin embargo, me metí a la aplicación “watch” y desvinculé las notificaciones de la aplicación “Alarmy” con el Apple Watch y problema resuelto. 

Desconozco si en la versión de paga se pueda seleccionar cualquier canción de la aplicación de “Apple Music ”, pero eso estaría genial.

Después intenté desinstalarla y aún así siguió sonando la alarma, aún con la aplicación desinstalada. La alarma siguió sonando hasta que apagué las notificaciones. En este momento, 12 horas después de la alarma original, si enciendo las notificaciones para la aplicación DESINSTALADA, sigue sonando la alarma. title: Voor de hardnekkige doorslaper
body:
Update Juli 26: sinds laatste re-install werkt de foto-functie niet meer. :( (iPhone 16pro) Scherm blijft zwart als je op “neem een foto” klikt.

Deze wekker is mijn redding. Gebruik de gratis versie en heb hem ingesteld op foto maken van m’n wasbak. Krijgt je echt uit bed. Er zit een kleine bug in dat als je er een andere wekker (bijv iPhone-wekker) naast gebruikt, bijvoorbeeld als je eerst een keer wil snoozen, en de snooze van de andere wekker gaat tijdens het afgaan va Alarmy, dan stopt het geluid volledig en gaat tot je de wekker uitzet alleen nog de trilfunctie af. Dus als je moeilijk wakker wordt en je snoozet graag even: let erop.
Daarnaast kan ook bij deze ringtones gewenning optreden voor de hardnekkige doorslaper ;) dus ik tuk af en toe nog rustig een kwartiertje door met een buzzende telefoon in m’n hand.
Desalniettemin voor mij de best werkende wekker!

title: Able to ignore, when done correctly it works great.
body:
It’s possible to overrule the alarm (turning on do not disturb mode when snoozed) but if the “how-to” is followed (app should be active in background when phone is set to silent) it’s a great system. 

Very convenient for medication, it can require a photo or barcode to dismiss the alarm. 

Using the barcode it’s much easier to get the image approved and alarm turned off. 

A photo is more light sensitive and background should be similar.

title: Totally amazing for biggest snoozer
body:
This is the first review I've ever done but had to do for this app!
For years I've been the worst at getting up- always had 20 alarms set, always snoozing every single one and never getting up on time..
This app CHANGED my mornings- you cannot snooze, lower the volume, or stop it! 
I have it set up to switch off only when I take a matching picture of a magazine I keep in the other room- so I do have to get up to make it stop. Loving the option to select a song from my music library so I wake up to something energetic and nice. I use it for 1 week now and absolutely love it! 
Recommend to everyone struggling with the snoozing and getting up. Thanks so much for making this app. XX

title: Great until it decides to not ring
body:
I’ve used this app for 7 years to wake me up, and had to delete it right now, as it’s recently been bugging out on me more and more. From simply not ringing on some days, to just vibrating, with this stupid AI voice telling me the day and hour, with no actual alarm sound other days. This despite the fact that I always double-check that my phone volume is up, and that it’s not on silent.

I can usually be quite forgiving when it comes to apps bugging out sometimes, but not when I rely on the same app to wake up to go to work.

On a good day, I’d rate it 4/5 stars, but the bugs drag it down to a 2.

title: Drained my whole battery
body:
Alarmy drained my whole battery while I was sleeping in the span of less than 6 hours. I had about 50% when I went to bed and according to my battery statistics. Alarmy drained my battery all the way to 0% somehow. Such a shame as I have been using this app for years without any issue, but I cannot risk this happening again. I will never use this app again.

My phone is a iPhone XS Max with 89% battery capacity. I never charge my phone at night. Usually I go to bed with ~20% and that has never been an issue, not even once.

I will happily share my statistics showing that Alarmy by itself drained my whole battery using “background activity”.

If the developers read this I would be happy to receive an explanation.

title: Used To Love This App
body:
Have been using alarmy on-and-off since 2017. I have recommended it to dozens of people. You couldn’t access all the features, but that was okay as the free alarm features were great. 
But when you began charging for more than half of the original “wake up” activities (that USED TO BE free!!!), I was not amused. 

The amount of ads playing have increased 10x what used to be there. I end up clicking dozens of them when waking up, so I’m giving you a lot of money through clicks. 

The icing on the cake is that you decreased the volume of the alarm!!! And you have to PAY to access the “other 70% of sound function.” 

So now, what used to be a loud alarm with loads of “wake up” features is just a money grab 😭

I now cannot wake up as I have severe insomnia and this alarm just useless. If you had ADDED features I may have considered paying, but the fact you are now charging for features that were previously free, is just scammy. I have started telling people to avoid the app, and will no longer be recommending it. 

Every time I try to post this review, it doesn’t get posted which is very suspicious.

title: MAJOR bugs + battery drain
body:
Deleted app once I noticed how much of a battery drain it is. How does an alarm clock app cause more drain on my battery than any other app on my phone?!

I will keep using the free version because it’s the only alarm I’ve found that will play through my headphones (thus not disturbing my partner when it goes off) and also plays downloaded songs from Apple Music. However, the severe and sometimes unpredictable bugs mean that it is not currently worth paying a subscription fee for to open up the locked features. Bugs include.. 1. The option to turn the alarm sound off when completing missions randomly and frequently decides not to work. Because of this I’ve uninstalled the alarm a few times to turn it off rather than complete the missions. 2. It is not optimised for my screen. The sleep quality screen is completely useless because a lot of it is not visible as it is severely zoomed in. Missions are also zoomed in and the bottom cut off the screen. This makes completing (particularly the memory game) difficult as the bottom row of boxes can barely be seen.

title: my battery could’ve exploded.
body:
It took me 2.5 hours before I finally woke up. When I checked my phone, the alarm was still vibrating nonstop and the ringtone failed to play. What worried me the most was that the phone had already overheated badly, and I couldn’t even stop the alarm with the side buttons. I only managed to shut it down after putting it in the fridge. If I hadn’t woken up when I did, it honestly felt like the phone could have exploded.

I use Alarmy because the iOS alarm just isn’t reliable.. it failed to wake me up at the right time multiple times. But after a week, even Alarmy started doing the same. So now, before going to sleep, I test it to see if it will play at max volume. Still, I honestly don’t know what to do anymore.

title: An alarm that actually works!
body:
As an honor student with many responsibilities, I often sleep late, leading to oversleep. Then I found Alarmy, and at the risk of sounding like early morning infomercials, I finally found my solution!

Literally "solution," as I use - and love - the Math mode. Set to Hard difficulty, I can wake up to a challenge of my mental capacities. I get to be awake enough to think, while also improving my mental arithmetic skills!

The other modes are also fun, though I don't use them to be honest.

Overall, this is a great app I never knew I needed.

title: You’ve ruined it:(
body: I don’t know what you’ve done to the app on the latest update but it’s RUINED. I started using Alarmy because I kept oversleeping every other week and not getting to work on time and it started getting embarrassing. Once I started using Alarmy, I woke up in time for work everyday. I eventually stopped using the alarm app on my iPhone. And now that I’ve started school I have to commute to another city everyday and really don’t want to be late. I updated the app and now it’s ruined. The alarm doesn’t go off sometimes. I know that because I’ve woken up before it goes off 3-5 times and not even touched my phone. And it hasn’t ringed. And when it does, the sound can barely be heard. And if you’re like me and you have a bad habit of pressing the side buttons on your phone when the alaram goes off, well…the alarm sound will go down to the lowest and will let you miss your bus or train or whatever 😭 WHAT THE HECK DID YOU DO, ALARMY?

title: Dragit pengar utan tillåtelse
body:
Hej,

Jag kontaktar er angående en debitering på 699,00 kr för Alarmy Pro (upphör 24 april 2027).

Jag vill tydligt framföra att jag inte medvetet har valt att prenumerera på denna tjänst. Jag valde enbart den kostnadsfria testperioden och har inte godkänt någon övergång till en betald prenumeration.

Trots detta har pengar dragits från mitt konto, vilket jag anser vara felaktigt. Dessutom använder jag inte appen och har inte haft någon nytta av tjänsten efter testperioden.

Med hänvisning till ovanstående ber jag om en full återbetalning av det debiterade beloppet samt att prenumerationen avslutas omedelbart.

Jag ser fram emot ert svar och en snabb lösning på detta ärende.

Vänliga hälsningar,
Maryam

title: Tveka inte ens!
body:
Tro mig, om du hela livet har haft problem att stiga upp så fort väckarklockan ringer så ladda ner Alarmy direkt. 
Spendera de kronorna premium-funktion kostar och du kommer aldrig mer behöva oroa dig för att inte gå upp tid. Funktionerna som appen erbjuder gör att det är helt omöjligt att somna om igen.

Sätt alarm när du måste upp, stäng av snooze funktionen (snooze är dåligt för din sömn) välj några uppgifter som du måste göra för att stänga av alarmet och låt en av de uppgifterna vara att du måste ta kort på något i tex badrummet. (När du redan är i badrummet varför skulle du vilja gå och lägg dig igen?), sen sätter du Wake-up checken på typ 5 minuter.
Som sagt, lyckas du somna om igen efter allt det då finns det inget som kan göra att du går upp i tid!

title: Bäst utan tvekan
body: Jag har använt mig av Alarmy i över ett år och sedan dess har jag endast försovit mig en endaste gång, denna specifika gången så glömde jag att aktivera larmet kvällen innan så det var inte helt oväntat. Man kan sätta på så många olika ljud i olika kombinationer varje minut varje morgon vilket låter SUPERHÖGT oavsett om man råkat sätta på ljudlöst eller inte. Jag vill säga att Alarmy är en garanti på att man vaknar. Den kostnadsfria Verisionen fungerar väl och det är fullt rimligt att man få upp lite reklam längst ned på kvällen för att med säkerhet kunna vakna på morgonen. Jag kan även rekommendera premium då det är omöjligt att stänga av det outhärdliga larmet förrän man har löst en utmaning, man kan välja att denna utmaning ska bars etr medelsvårt mattetal (t.ex 271+75) vilket gör att man måste klarna lite i huvudet och vakna innan man kan stänga av larmet. Jag rekommenderar alla som har problem med att vakna på morgonen att använda sig av Alarmy, för alltid!

title: Make it more customizable!
body:
Let me first say I can’t live without this app. At least I’d have a hard time keeping a job without it. That said, it’s gone from great to not so great, and I ask you to step up your game because I’ll jump ship as soon as I find a decent replacement.

What’s with that bloody horoscope? Why are you trying to force some quasi-religious crap on me? Don’t implement such a BS feature without the option to hide it from the summary! F that!

Another thing is the news section. Until quite recently, it was a good way for me to come to my senses while waiting for the Wake Up Check. It got the brain going. Nowadays I wake up just from pure frustration every day because 9/10 articles are pay-walled, making the whole thing utterly useless!

I don’t know what service you’re using for news, but they need to let users decide which outlets to source, or you need to look for another provider! The whole news section is in desperate need of some user customizability. The whole app is! Give us more options if you want us to keep paying for a friggin’ subscription!

One feature that would help me a lot would be the option to set individual pictures for each alarm. Also a language setting for the text-to-speech would make it more useful.

title: Good alarm, poor monetization strategy
body:
I love the photo alarm feature because it helps be get out of bed in the morning. I would like to support the creators and get rid of the ads but making this a subscription based service and asking $50 (~450SEK) per year is too steep. I can’t get behind that. 

Recently I also received a unsolicited notification that the app had a birthday and there was a contest being run. This is spam-like behavior. You need to have notifications enabled for the app in order to have it save you if you accidentally kill the app in the background (great feature) so you will need to have notifications on. And since there is no controls for selecting relevant notifications you cannot escape notifications like these. 

5 star functionality in a 3 star package (minus for being too expensive and sending irrelevant notifications). If the app’s unique functionality is key to your survival then go for it. I will be looking for a different app with a more reasonable pricing model.

title: Battery usage
body:
Background activity... That word pretty much sums it up. 

I’ve loved this app up until just now, always worked great, it has woken me up countless times. BUT for some reason it has started using more and more battery... Tonight this one single handedly killed my iPhone’s battery during my sleep - which led to the obvious situation of no alarm... According to the ”battery-usage” report in the phone, this app just accelerated, through 11 pm-12 am it used ”only” 59%, going further through 12 am-1 am 92%, and last but not least through 1 am-2 am 100%. 

Yesterday I would’ve recommended this app, today - not so much. It has to go.
