title: Problems with the latest update
body:
I loved this app. As someone who has figured out how to disable every other phone and real alarm in my sleep, Alarmy had finally solved my problems.

Now, the latest update could be the end.

When you go to edit an alarm or make a new one, you’ll now be told background app refresh is needed for Alarmy to work. You can’t save any changes to an alarm unless you enable it. The app locks you in, unable to proceed. Now, I’ve never allowed background app refresh so I know that’s just not true that it is needed. But I do need to shift the time on this alarm... so I try to obey.

Well, if you have turned on low power mode, background app refresh is disabled. So first you have to turn that off. Then if you go to background app refresh, you can’t even selectively enable it for Alarmy. Alarmy isn’t even on the app list. You have to all-or-nothing enable. Shady af. Well, I do this long enough to change the alarm, and then I go back and turn off background app refresh and turn on low power mode. 

Again, I’ve NEVER allowed background app refresh and Alarmy had worked fine. It’s one thing to suggest it in-app, like Tile does. Another to force it so the app is not functional until I comply with something I know to be unnecessary from regular use (and which strikes me as shady since I can’t even individually enable it for Alarmy even if I wanted to). 

If this isn’t resolved in the next update, I’ll have to delete. I just can’t add a million steps every night just to tweak my alarm. (I have to tweak it regularly because I work at client sites and my wake up time varies a lot by where the site is and how far I have to drive.) Yes, I’m sure there are workarounds like creating a million alarms at each 10 min mark so I can enable/disable each one instead of changing the time for my one Weekday alarm. But I should NOT have to do this. I’d sooner delete the app.

title: I have a love/hate relationship with this alarm
body:
I’m a person that can hit snooze and fall right back to sleep. I’ve been known to snooze for more than 2 hours. Consequently, I have always had to set my alarms way early and am always tired and frantic in the mornings. 

Then I discovered Alarmy. I left the snooze option off, made the alarm a favorite song, and set it so I have to scan the barcode of the shampoo in the shower to turn it off. When that alarm first goes off, all I want to do is shut it off. I’ve even tried turning the volume down. Nope, Alarmy turns it right back up. So I hate it for about half a song, then that hook hits and I’m singing and rockin’ and up starting my day in less than 5 minutes. It’s a miracle! I love it! I’m sleeping better and waking more refreshed. Alarmy is the best thing to happen to my mornings. 

I also like the white noise machine at night and getting my horoscope, weather, and news in the morning. If I could make one suggestion, it would be an option to set a number of snoozes allowed, as opposed to just the length of snooze. Waking up with Alarmy would be perfect with ONE snooze. Thanks for reenergizing my mornings.

title: Best Alarm Clock I’ve Used
body: My whole life I’ve always had an extremely rough experience with waking up in the morning. I have a tendency to be unable to sleep at night, but sleep heavy in the daytime. Growing up, my mother would try and force me awake which sometimes wasn’t completely successful. I’m older now, and though my life has adjusted to later night shifts and late afternoon classes, I soon had to start taking some morning courses for school. My biggest problem is that I wake up to regular alarm clocks, do something on my phone and go back to sleep. I’m literally like a zombie in the morning, so much so that I tend not to remember conversations, texts, etc. upon waking up. I soon got desperate after buying many different kinds of alarm clocks, and I found this app. Alarmy wakes my mind up in the AM. I use the math problem mission on the app which makes me answer math problems upon waking up. I love the fact that you can pick the difficulty of the math problems as well as how many.This has for sure gotten me out of my dazed state in the mornings.Also the alarm tones available are very loud and I don’t sleep through them. After buying and trying so many other alarm clocks and apps, I’m so happy that I found alarm and I highly recommend this app!

title: Worst Best Alarm
body:
Every morning it would be my sole mission to dismiss any alarm I used to wake me up. It got so bad that I would never wake up on time because of my raging desire to sleep. This alarm however is my worst nightmare.

I set an alarm with this app where I have to scan the code off the back of my tooth paste (forcing me far away from my bed) and countless mornings I have tried to not do just that. I have tried any and every loop hole I can possibly think of (excluding snooze bc I disabled it) and have failed miserably. The best ive gotten was a few seconds of closing my eyes before the alarm sets off again. Even if you close the app with the phone on silent it will still buzz an infinite amount of times with a notification popping up letting you know: yes, your alarm is still going off.

I definitely give this app 5 stars because I have only been late to work once in six months, which was because my phone was on silent with the app closed before I went to bed causing the alarm to not go off, but I cannot complain about this since a notification will pop on the screen saying thats what will happen.

Overall, great alarm. I never thought I could fix my sleep schedule until I found this app.

title: Perfect
body:
My whole life, every time I went to bed, my mom would say “set an alarm so I don’t have to come and get you up!” So I would just set the normal Apple alarm, (3 or 4 of them) and totally sleep through them. I never even remembered turning them off! My mom would have to come upstairs and turn on my light every morning. 
So things really had to change when I came to college, where my mom was not just a floor away. I’ve definitely missed many a morning class, until one Christmas break when I complained about my problem to my sister, and she showed me Alarmy! 
It really is perfect. My favorite alarm (as favorite as an alarm can be... I still don’t like waking up in the morning) is the barcode scanner. You can choose literally any barcode on any object you own, and set your alarm to not turn off until you’ve scanned that barcode. I use the candle on my desk so that it forces me to get out of bed. Works like a charm, although it might be useful to have something to scan in another room, so I can’t just stumble back into bed. That’s on me.
The best part is, I looked for something like this years ago, but had to pay for it. Being an unemployed teen, I had no income, so no way was I gonna shell out a whole dollar for an app. That’s what hooked me on Alarmy... I got to try it out (and use it forever) for free. It’s all the quality you could want without the price tag. You really won’t be disappointed.

title: Perfect
body: I don’t think I’ve ever written an app review in over a decade of iPhone use. This alarm is that good. I’m not exaggerating when I say that this app has changed my life. I have, on more than one occasion, slept through an alarm clock going off for 2 hours. When I was using the built-in iPhone alarm, I’d have to set 10-15 alarms to be sure I’d get up on time. With Alarmy, I set one backup and rarely ever do I need it. I even get up 3-4 hours earlier than I’ve ever managed to before. There are enough customizations available that you can easily switch things up when your groggy morning alter-ego starts to outsmart your current settings. I just bought the paid version, not because the adds are that annoying, but out of genuine appreciation for what this app has done for me. I like the barcode scanner and the picture mission. My first alarm makes me go to the kitchen to scan a barcode. Once I’m already there, it’s already lot harder to talk myself back into bed. If I do decide to “hit the snooze”, I take a cup of coffee back to bed with me and catch a few more winks, until my picture mission alarm goes off and sends me to my laptop to get to work. I’d give more than 5 stars if I could. If you are a terrible over-sleeper like I was, you have to try this.

title: Life Saver!
body:
Once upon a time, I would snooze/dismiss through all 6-7 of my alarms without even remembering it! I tried out an app similar  to Alarmy that I loved, but often had glitches (my alarm would straight up not go off sometimes). So I set out for something similar. Enter Alarmy. I loved the last app, but I love Alarmy 20x’s more. I’m going to list my favorite features!
1. You can pick your mission and it’s difficulty (I didn’t have a choice with my last app) 
2. You can have your different alarm times saved and have different missions for each alarm. My half asleep self doesn’t know what to expect when I wake up! 
3. You can change the wallpaper of the app to whatever picture you want. 
4. Once I complete my mission and wake up for the day, I’m automatically taken a page where I can view the day’s weather, my horoscope, and top news (I have never been so informed about what’s going on the world before). 
5. I have never had an issue with glitches! 

Thanks to Alarmy, I actually wake up for my morning workouts! This app has seriously changed my life. THANK YOU!

title: Great App, Just A Few Suggestions
body:
This app is AMAZING. I use it every morning to wake up on time. I am a very busy person, so it makes it useful to actually wake up on time for once. All I have to do is turn on my ringer, charge my phone, and go to sleep.

Don’t get me wrong—I love this app. But every app needs improvements.

First: reminders. I am a very forgetful person, and I need to remember things in the morning. I thought, what if there was a way to remind myself of things in the morning, like before I did my math problems, or before I scanned the QR code in my bathroom. I think this would make it really awesome for people who need to remember things.

Second: Bedtime. Similar to Apple’a Bedtime feature, what if there was a reminder every night to tell you to go to bed.

Third: Sleep tracking. I would like to have a feature where I could say in the app right when I’m about to go to bed, every time I wake up in the night, and when I wake up (probably when my alarm goes off, or if I don’t set one). I would like to see how many hours I am actually getting of sleep.

If you’re the developer and you’re reading this, thank you for making such an awesome app, and I hope you take my suggestions into consideration.

title: best alarm ever
body:
I am a high school student who takes a sleep aid for insomnia and always had difficulty waking up in the morning because I would just turn off normal alarms half awake and then sleep through them. I was up one night trying to find a good alarm to use when I found this one. 
It. Has. Changed. My. Life. 
I haven’t been to school late since I started using this alarm. The many options for sound and for how you dismiss it are amazing and soooo helpful if you’re not a morning person or take a sleep aid like I do. I no longer feel like a zombie in the morning! 
Another amazing thing this app has is the ‘sleep music’ aspect of it. Listening to the rain sounds helps me fall asleep every night without fail (and it’s on a timer so it stops after a certain point). So helpful and makes me feel so peaceful. 
I truly have enjoyed this app. I get up on time, even have time to make myself breakfast every morning!!! 
I highly recommend this to any student who has to get up before the sun rises that is NOT a morning person. It’s a little annoying at first (in a good way because it truly gets you up) but you learn to appreciate it. 
Bravo to the developers who created this! I hope you know how much you’ve done for us night owls :)

body:

We have tried everything from setting our phones across the room, to louder alarms, music, hiding the phone somewhere so we have to look for it when the alarm is going off...nothing worked consistently. I was ready to purchase an expensive alarm that would roll away from us so we would have to catch it because I was out of ideas. Thankfully I read a blog post about Alarmy and it has been life changing. For almost two months now, my husband and I have been able to get up ON TIME, we get the things done that we need to get done in the morning, we get out the door on time, and best of all, we are not stressed about it because we both woke up with time to spare. 

We both use the picture alarm which forces us to walk downstairs and match the picture on our phone. I like that there are multiple options to help different kinds of sleepers wake up. I also like that there is a variety of options for alarm sounds and night time sounds to help you fall asleep. It is also incredibly easy to use. We love this app and will continue to use it.

title: A game-changer
body:
I’ve always had a bad habit of turning off an alarm and immediately falling back asleep, to the point where I spent most of college  physically hiding my phone in random places before bed to make sure I actually got up. Alarmy’s barcode scanner function gives me the same result, plus I can keep my phone next to me and charging at night. 

The barcode scanner is also an amazing fool-proof medication reminder. It’s honestly a necessity to anyone taking something like birth control where missed dosages are bad news.

Alarmy also has great customization features, like setting the length and number of snoozes you can use. I’ve found that setting an alarm for 15 minutes before I need to actually be up and about, and allowing for three 5-minute snooze periods is perfect for me. 

The only problem I've encountered is when an item your supposed to scan/photograph isn’t available. I’ve forgotten cancel a barcode scanner alarm when I went out of town a couple of times now and could only turn it off by completely uninstalling the app and having to start from scratch. A solution I’ve seen on similar apps is for scanning to be automatically disabled when it detects you’re away, either through location services or being disconnected from your home WiFi.

Overall, love this app. I’ve tried other barcode alarms but none have the wide variety of extra features Alarmy does. I recommend it to all of my friends and will continue to do so for as long as it exists.

title: It Wakes the Unwakeable!!
body:
My entire life, it’s been nearly impossible to wake me up. My friends, family, and boyfriend make jokes about my sleeping alter-ego, who will do and/or say ANYTHING to make you go away. When I wake naturally, hours later, there is no recollection of any interactions I had during my slumber. It’s kind of embarrassing to find out you did jumping jacks to make your best friend go away during a nap!

When my boyfriend had a car accident last year, he became paralyzed from the chest down. He lives alone with me, and there are things we need to do (medically) at certain times in the night. I was so scared when I learned we would need to wake 2-3x every night. Especially because it could be dangerous for him to miss one. 

I knew I would need a better alarm. This was so much more important than missing class or a meeting...my boyfriend’s health was on the line. We tried multiple alarms at their loudest setting. I cried every time we discovered we missed one. 

After searching the App Store, I discovered Alarmy. This app is AMAZING!! It bypasses the max-volume on the phone and gets so much louder than I knew it was capable of. It worked perfectly on my old phone (iPhone SE), and is just as perfect on my new phone (iPhone XR). This screaming alarm works every time and pulls me from my sleep. 

But it doesn’t end there! Next, I’ve set it to give me five difficult math problems to solve. If I don’t answer one of them fast enough - it will reset, the alarm will scream, and my five problems will reset. It’s perfect!! I think it gives my mind enough time to wake up and remember why I set the alarm in the first place. 

Thank you for making my life easier and my boyfriend’s life safer! This alarm has given us such peace of mind!!

It got to the point where I was almost consistently late for my graduate school internship & risked losing it. 

I can honestly say Alarmy changed the game for me. After downloading this app, I managed not to miss another morning of internship due to oversleeping (something I was VERY anxious about) & just graduated this past December. The wake-up exercises (I lean toward math & the memory game), as well as the soothing sound options, have helped SO much with waking up & have really helped me take control of my morning in a way other alarm apps have not. I plan to continue using it as I head into the post-grad job life, & I love having the security that I’m going into a full-time job with an alarm that actually works for me! I highly recommend this app.

title: So let me tell you about my day...
body:
So story time for you all this morning. I struggle waking up in the morning, every day the snooze button makes a much more compelling argument than scraping the ice off my car and driving to work. But I was determined to change my ways, and so I downloaded a new alarm (Alarmy) .

Basically you set an alarm and it won't shut off that alarm until you do something, there are a number of different options; solve a riddle, remember a pattern, or as I chose, solve a math problem.

I figured, I was always good at math and it will get my brain kick started in the morning, win win right?

Well gang, prepare for a spoiler alert, cause I was wrong. Very, very wrong.

I generally set 2 alarms, the first at 5:45 to get me out of deep sleep, and the second at 6:15 to start getting ready for work. My first alarm goes off this morning and I roll over to look at the problem in front of me. And NO it's not 15+27, it's not even 8*9, it's damned algebra. Something like (19*41)+554= your alarm is now annoying the hell out of everyone in this house.

Now I'm panicking. I can't do this in my head as I'm still sleep groggy and every 20 second I don't solve this problem it's blasting my alarm at full volume. I race across the room to grab a pen and paper. Surprise number 2! If you don't solve the problem fast enough and just let the alarm blast instead it eventually moves on to a new problem.

I come back to my loud as hell phone with the solution to all of my problems only to find out we're onto problem numero dos!

Needless to say I'm now wide awake.

So lets jump forward a bit gang. I figure there is no going back to bed after that as my alarm just blasted the entire upstairs with the smooth sountrack of a bank vault robbery gone wrong for the last 15 min, so instead I start driving to work.

But wait! Gold damned star to anyone who realized it before my sleep addled brain did.

Yup! ALARM NUMBER 2!

So now I'm driving in my car in rush hour traffic trying to solve math problems. I owe my 3rd grade math teacher Mr. Driscoll an apology, because apparently, yes I would eventually use those math skills in real life.

Last part I swear. I pulled off the highway and into a mall parking lot to try and shut this nightmare fuel alarm off. Speakers still blasting out the alert that Fort Knox has fallen. When wouldn't you guess, a local 5-0 heard the commotion and pulled up behind me to figure out what on earth was going on.

Needless to say I didn't go back to bed and I'm now wide awake. So I rated the app 5 stars.

 TL;DR - This is the most awake I’ve ever been at 6:30AM

title: Recommended for deep sleepers!!!
body:
I’ve been using this app for almost a year now and it works very well! If you are a deep sleeper, or just aren’t a very good morning person(I am both lol), then this app would be great for you! title: Complete Life Changer
body: I’ve never been able to be a morning person, even though I have dreams of being so. I’ve had to try many different alarm clocks because well, my body seems to find a way to turn off every single alarm while I’m still half-asleep. Nothing has worked for me. However, I found this app about a month or two ago and have been using it every single morning. It’s extremely unique, and well, it’s a life changer for me. I can find motivation to stay awake and stay busy in the morning, but finding the motivation to get out of bed first thing is the first and largest problem with my ENTIRE day. I love the fact that you can set missions for your alarms, not to mention there’s a selection. I also love the little news board in the app. I find that this app works so well am for me. I’ll set a gentle tone for when I want to wake up, and set a mission like the memory game or math problems(I have to switch them up). Then I’ll set a second annoying alarm for around 2-5 minutes after my first one that requires me to get out of bed and scan an object in my kitchen. I’ll make myself scan things that I enjoy, like my box of English or Irish breakfast tea, and it gives me a reason to stay awake. Not to mention that reading a quick horoscope or news article in the morning helps my mind to get a jump start! It’s just overall really great, and customizable. The sleep music is really amazing too, though I have a meditation app I prefer at night. There’s really something for everyone on this app, from the lightest sleeping morning bird to the heavy sleeping night owl. It’s helped me so much. 🙏🏻🙏🏻🙏🏻 Take this advice from someone who turns their alarm across the room off, in their sleep, every morning. This app is my lifesaver. 💜

title: Top notch functionality and design - a rare combo
body:

-shows you weather and news when you turn off your alarm
-lets you set up alarm so you have to scan barcode to turn it off, making you move far to get up
-unobtrusive ads, unlike most other free apps
-can set alarm sound to random so it’s a surprise each day 
-when you’re setting alarm time, it tells you “this will go off 7 hours and 35 minutes” or whatever it is for you which is helpful when aiming to get a certain amount of sleep
-has nice custom backgrounds

Downsides
-if you have do not disturb on and ringer off then alarm won’t go off in the morning (they warn you the first time you are at risk but not after that)
-[spoiler] can still turn off alarm by shutting off phone or force quitting app and turning on do not disturb, so it would be nice if they had an option where if you don’t scan the barcode you pay $1 or something like that

title: Best thing to happen to my career EVER
body: I’ve been battling thyroid issues for years. One of the fun side effects of hypothyroidism is intense fatigue. I live an hour from my office and commute every morning. With every other alarm i have ever tried, I would set my alarm for 5am with the best of intentions, and hit the snooze for an hour...or 2...and would inevitably show up 15-30 minutes late for work 2-3 times per week. I would also lose productivity in the mornings from my mad rush out the door. I have to use the “take a picture” function because it forces me out of bed. I set my picture to something in the kitchen so that once I’m there, I can immediately start making my coffee and force myself to stay up. I can then take my time getting ready for work and actually look like a put-together professional rather than dragging in late with rumpled clothes and “red-light rush eyeliner”. Since I started using Alarmy 3 months ago I haven’t been late to work once, and my focus and general attitude have improved immensely. I was promoted to Manager at my CPA firm last week, a year ahead of when I’d originally been told I could realistically expect any kind of promotion, citing the rapid improvement in my general work ethic and overall comportment. I credit this app with 90% of that. Please please PLEASE keep this app running FOREVER!!!

author: Shay Riley

title: Never Written A Review But WOW
body: Alright. Listen. It's 12:33 and I should be sleeping cause i'm a procrastinating student haha #collegelyfe am I right men, gals and non-binary pals?? Ok but anyways, I sleep through everything, and I mean everything. Throughout the years my family has started having to throw things at me to get me up, like cups full of dog food, water, more dog food. (we have 6 dogs so it's kinda more present in our house than our food is) and like you know, I'm almost 20 now and I can't depend on others to wake up. Like I really can't i'm gonna be alone soon in my own place (i have one dog with me though she's cool but i don't think she's gonna help much) SO i've been trying out different alarms and methods of getting up. Last night I decided to try this app. Let Me Tell You Something About Horror Pal. I thought to myself "Oh yeah I can TOTALLY do 3 BASIC math problems as a way to turn off the alarm". Upon the alarm blaring under my ear at 8AM /sharp/ I began frantically trying to do math. And let me tell you, I'm no genius at math to begin with. So I'm punching in random numbers trying to stop the timer from going down to set off the alarm again and i'm struggling, i'm shaking, I am full on quaking. My palms fill with sweat, I can see my ancestors ghosts appearing and telling me how much I am letting them down. I hear babies crying, people screaming in the streets. Complete chaos has broken out. I'm gripping my phone as well as I can and trying to think back to 2nd grade. "Come ON COME ON" I scream to myself, "WHAT IS 23+" but the alarm starts blaring again. It gives me a new math problem. I have to start over again. I am crying, my dog next to me is crying too. I take a deep breath. There's only one thing left to do. I stand up and I start running. I haven't stopped running since, the alarm keeps going off every 10 seconds after leaving the app. I've been writing this message for 3 years. But Really Great App! I've Never Felt So Awake In My Life!(:

title: The alarm that actually wakes me up
body:
I’m known to have multiple alarms to help wake me up in the morning. I’m talking several set 15 min apart just because I will snooze or turn them off completely and still not get up. 

After finding Alarmy, I’ve been waking up consistently every morning at the same time, and the best part is I only need one alarm to go off, so my husband is a lot happier too! I use the picture method and have it set so I have to take a picture of my bathroom sink. By the time I take the picture, I’m awake enough I don’t even want to crawl back in bed. This has been a life changer for me since I now wake up earlier enough to get my workout done before work. 

My only critic would be for the app to open when the alarm goes off. Right now the alarm will go off and I have to open the app instead of it just opening automatically. But even then it’s not a big pain since I’ve now just placed the app icon on my home screen so I don’t have to fumble through folders looking for it. 

I truly love this app and contribute a bulk of my lifestyle change success to it. Thank you alarmy!! 5/5

title: Annoying Default Setting
body: This app is great for waking me up as I have trouble sleeping through my alarm. However, today it didn’t go off at all because when I set my alarm, it defaulted to only set off during weekdays. So it didn’t go off this morning, I woke up over two hours late and missed a meeting with three of my clients. It’s annoying to me because I find it ridiculous to assume that people only need an alarm during the week because apparently everyone has a normal Monday through Friday job, right? It should default to set off on any day when you’re setting your alarm, just like the iPhone alarm does. I’m still going to use the app, now that I know that I need to change the setting, but I just wanted to put this out there so someone else doesn’t have the same issue as me. It’s not fair to assume that people only need an alarm during the week.

title: Speechless!
body:
This app is hands down amazing! I have to be honest, every alarm app I tried worked for a while but me and my sleepy self found away around them like turning my phone off completely when the alarm goes off, just pressing the stop button and going back to sleep, and eventually I could just sleep through it. One day, I found this app and downloaded it, I set it on math problems and for the first time in years, I finally woke up myself! Another thing I really like is the weather feature and for an app that weather is not it’s specialty, it also is my favorite because A) it tells me the weather and B) it compares it to the day before it which I think is amazing. Another feature is the news feature. Every morning I can read what is going on. Lastly, the white noise, don’t even get me started, you have no idea how much that white noise has helped me get to sleep. One thing I forgot to mention, is the face that this app is 100% free!! The only payment that can be made is for 0.99 and is to remove adds, and to be quite honest with you the adds really don’t bother me much. The thing is, this app actually cares about its users, the one time I had a problem, I sent an email and the team helped me in less than 24 hours! Every person that on the Alarmy team is devoted to their users, they care more about them than the money the get out of it, and nowadays, that’s not easy to find. I recommend this app to anyone and everyone it is just amazing, I love the quality of this app, I love everything about it from its people to the app it’s self.

Thanks for reading! 

-Jax

With my first problem, I found the solution is to disable uninstalling with a Screen Time pin I won't remember (it is written down somewhere).

With that said, this doesn't address the second issue: How do I stop myself from disabling all the alarms when I don't want to wake up? I always end up disabling them and then sleeping in, which is far less than ideal. I can't find the option to stop myself from doing this.

title: Only alarm I use// EDIT: HARD OF HEARING
body:
I am a very deep sleeper with morning classes. I have trouble waking up in the mornings and will often reset or turn off alarms completely without being aware of what I’m doing. The variety of the options helps wake me in the morning, I start usually with a shake alarm, then a math one, then finally a barcode I scanned somewhere in the kitchen. It forces me to wake up at the math alarm because I am terrible with math, but the added benefit is my math skills are getting strong because I keep having to up the difficulty.  Thanks so much, you’ve made my professors hate me significantly less since I can almost now make it to class on time.

EDIT/UPDATE: I had my hearing checked six months ago and found out from a doctor I have Hearing Loss. (Mild/Moderate but still significant for not knowing till age 26) Since getting my hearing aids my life has changed in so many ways I couldn’t have imagined, there’s so much sound to hear! It’s shocking to me, but makes sense, but also is just so wild to hear; it’s changed my life. But it has also made sense why this alarm is the ONLY alarm I can trust to wake me up fully since I now know sound alone is unreliable, I need mental engagement and stimulation to wake up fully without causing more damage to my tender little ears. It’s made me just appreciate this alarm more and more as it’s the only one of its kind I can seem to find.

title: Regular alarms are a joke compared to Alarmy!
body:
The days of sleeping through my alarms are almost a forgotten thing of the past. I can hardly remember the bliss of waking up without an alarm, only to be hit with the horrifying realization that I was late for work! Babies don’t sleep as good as I do, so when it comes to waking me up it has always been as difficult as fighting a ln angry grizzly bear bare handed. No big deal for Alarmy though! 

The tones are actually enjoyable, who knew that was even possible? I always thought the whole purpose was to choose the most obnoxious, annoying alarm sound possible, but now I wake up peacefully with a serene melody (loudly) coaxing me from my slumber. 

And the math! I love the sense of accomplishment I feel every single morning before my feet ever even touch my fuzzy slippers. Again, who would have ever fathomed I’d enjoy doing math, let alone doing math before having any coffee. Sparks my brain right up and I’m awake without a snooze.

I’ll say it again for the people in the back. NO SNOOZE NECESSARY.

It’s a miracle, a godsend, a second coming of Christ known as... 

Alarmy.

title: Gets you out of bed
body:
I have often struggled with making myself actually get out of bed and start my day after dismissing my alarm in the morning. Although there are multiple ways of dismissing an alarm with Alarmy, the most effective one for me is the photo option. I set the original photo, such as an object in my bathroom, then every morning I need to get up and take a photo of that same object in order to turn off the alarm. It’s brilliant. 

The only issue that I hope will eventually be fixed for iOS users is that if the photo alarm goes off and it is actually impossible for you to take the photo (perhaps you spend the night elsewhere), then there is no way to stop the alarm beyond uninstalling the app. Simply remembering to adjust alarms accordingly as needed should eliminate this as an issue but it’s possible to forget.

title: Great when it works
body:
When it works, this app is fantastic! It forces me to take a picture to prove I’m out of bed, and it’s the only way I’ve been able to consistently get up at 4am to exercise.

The problem is that sometimes the alarm goes off as planned, but sometimes it just remains silent and sends a ton of notifications (which is apparently a common problem with this app). The developers keep saying that it’s related to silent mode and Do Not Disturb mode; I always have my phone on silent mode (but with the volume turned up), and my DND is scheduled every night. I always make sure the volume is up and the app is running in the background. With the exact same setup every night, it should work the same way every time, but instead my results are unpredictable.

My solution has been to set a regular alarm for 1 minute after the Alarmy one is set to go off. That way, if Alarmy fails to ring, the regular alarm will wake me up, and then once you unlock your phone, Alarmy works normally (so I still get my 2 snoozes and forced photo).

body:
This is an amazing app if you can’t wake up properly. 

I’ve learned to turn regular alarms off in my sleep (thus sleeping way past when I should be awake), but Alarmy won’t shut up until you’ve completed the mission 😅. If you try to turn the volume down, it will go back up to full volume until you swipe and start solving whatever mission you have set. (Quite helpful for snapping you awake)

I’d recommend doing basic math (flip to calculator app, add the three numbers, flip back to Alarmy, enter answer). 

I also like the memorize squares mission if I’m taking a nap and don’t fall into a deep sleep. 

While I haven’t tried it, if you’re a really thought sleeper, I’d suggest taping a QR code somewhere far away from your bed (bathroom or kitchen or closet) so that you have to get out of bed to scan the code. 

Really love this app and it saved me a lot of times 👌🏻 just make sure it’s on in the background over night so that the alarm works^^

title: Great for snooze button addicts
body: For years I had to set 5-8 different alarms just to get up in the morning. I love this app!!! It gets me up after just one alarm. Bonus is that it allows you to select songs from your music library. The music gets progressively louder the longer you keep from opening it and working on the solution or “mission.” If you don’t solve correctly, it will go off again, guaranteeing you don’t go back to sleep. Finally, I really like that it tells you, as you start to adjust to the time you want to wake up, how much time you have to sleep before the alarm goes off. It’s a good reminder to have when you’re getting only about 4-5 hours of sleep a night and you want to make sure you do get that much and not less. Highly recommend for anyone else who needs extra help getting up in the morning.

title: Their horoscopes are THE BOMB. Hear me out...
body:
This alarm is awesome, I use it every single day in conjunction with my Apple alarm, it’s great. BUT today I’m going to share with you the REAL REASON as to why you should download this app. While the application it’s self is wonderful and awesome, I’m here to rave about their HOROSCOPES. I know, it’s a tiny feature on their app, so when you wake up to turn off the alarm, it opens to a screen with the weather for the day, News that’s important, AND a daily horoscope. This is what I look forward to every morning. Why you ask? Well, it’s not one of those super broad ones that’s like, “an exciting time is coming..” No! It’s, “Be careful, you are busy today” which ok, may seem broad, but I got that on Valentine’s Day and I work at a flower shop! So yea! It IS the busiest day of THE YEAR. I’ve gotten, “you may be disappointed by someone close to you. DONT BLAME YOURSELF for giving too much expectation to them. Things happen :/ The person may bring you a smile again someday” SEE? Detailed, precise, and again, spot on! The day before, I got into a car accident and the next day once my husband processed everything that happened to his truck, (I was 100% fine, zero injuries) we got into a huge fight, partially about this, partially about a bunch of other stuff and we had to talk about it the next day which was the day I got this horoscope. I mean.. come on. For all it knew, It could have sent me something like, “today is a great beautiful day, a loved one is excited to talk to you” but No! It sent me that! 
But lastly, what prompted me to write this review about their horoscopes was today’s. Yesterday, I came up with an idea to surprise my husband on his birthday (we’ve talked, we’re all good now and his truck is back in good shape, thanks for asking) he’s currently deployed with the military and he can’t get phone calls or texts so I asked a bunch of our friends and families to write him a card to make it special since none of us can be there with him. Wanna hear today’s horoscope? (I’m gonna tell you anyway but if you’ve made it this far in my review, I’m sure you’re on the edge of your seat :D) “Wow. Some ties and connections of the past may help you today. Some of your good deed in the past is returning. Let’s see how things go today!” I mean, I’m literally texting people I haven’t talked to in MONTHS and it says people from my past will help me?? Sign me up!! Idk I honestly don’t put much weight into horoscopes to begin with but it’s so fun to see how accurate it can be that day and Today I just got very excited and wanted to actually write a review because it’s become a part of my life that I look forward to every day and I love it :) Thank you Alarmy ❤️

title: Cured My 27-Year Wakeup Problem
body:
For 27 years I’ve lived with the fact that I can’t expect to wake up reliably in the morning, I’m just not wired for it. I would literally snooze an alarm every 9 minutes for two to three HOURS, that’s how heavy a sleeper I am. Finding this app was the result of me finally getting fed up and searching “extreme measures for waking up in the morning” on google. I was ready to try electric shock, physical force, property damage, anything. 

This app has completely turned my life around. I’m able to get up early every day and I actually feel more refreshed than I did when I used to wake up 2 hours later. I have it set so the alarm won’t turn off until I go downstairs and scan the barcode on my coffee box, and since I’m down there I may as well make a cup of coffee. And by that time I’m ready to get up. 

I can say confidently that this is the best app I’ve ever had on my iPhone. I feel like a changed man.

title: Do Not Skim Over Or Pass By
body:
This “wakey, wakey” alarm app truly does work!! From my point of view, it was created for people like me. Someone who despises waking up in the morning, EARLY morning. Ok, it’s not even about the time of day. It’s about the awful task we make our bodies do every single day....WAKE UP! **There are some who have internal clocks. Whoopee Doo Daa**

Prior to using this app, I was, well, late getting to the awake part. After that, “late” was the lead in every step and action I took. Because I WAS a habitual “snoozer”, this meant I was a Plus 1 for the alarm clock blame game (You’re a Plus II if there’s 2 bodies waking up to one alarm clock.) 

For every minor quirk that took 30 seconds here or 3 1/2 minutes there, that would cause me to fall behind, emm hmm late, I blamed it on my “snooze” time. I’ve heard the campfire stories about this “Easy Fix” for the blame game. Goes something like this: alarm clock goes off, right away the person wakes up, hops out of bed, day gets rolling. Right? HA! I scoff at such story. 

Now, if ANY of the above strikes a similarity with you, or someone you know, do yourself and them a favor.....download AND use this app!! I promise you, you will have your own campfire story to tell. 

From day one, using this alarm clock, I’ve failed to oversleep, I’ve failed to be late and even failed to play the blame game. I’ve tried every combination imaginable (for me) and not one I tell ya, NOT ONE has failed me yet. Have trouble getting to sleep? There’s an option to play background noise, such as light rain, hard rain, waves, etc., and for how long. Whether it be 2 hours or 10 minutes. All the while, there’s a little clock showing the amount of “sleep” time remaining before the big show arrives. And yes, for most, way too early in the morning.

title: Great Alarm App
body:
I didn’t get this alarm for the “annoying” tasks to wake me up, but I can see how they would be useful if I didn’t get any sleep. 

I really like having the ability to set the alarm volume independently of the ringer volume because I often listen to music or podcasts at a low volume to fall asleep but I need a super loud alarm in the morning. Great feature that you would think was a no brainer but so many apps don’t have it. I also like that as long as the app is on in the background, ringer volume and silent switch settings don’t matter. My ringer is turned off 90% of the time at home to avoid getting notification noises but again, I need my alarm to work anyway. 

Setting the alarms is a super easy task. Alarms tones are great. 

Another really awesome feature is the sleep sounds you can play at night. Very cool. I was able to not only delete my old alarm app, but my White Noise app as well. 

Thanks for making the app free so I could try it too. I paid for the upgrade in minutes. So worth it. 

Great app!!

title: Sometimes works, sometimes doesn’t.
body:
Not sure what the deal is. I always keep the app running in the background, I always turn silent mode off when I set my iPhone X down to charge for the night, and I restart the app regularly. I tried to follow the instructions in the app’s info section, but actual results are ambiguous. The alarm goes off inconsistently, sometimes ringing, other times silent. I wear my apple watch to sleep to track heart rate and sleep data, and the watch always vibrates when the alarm goes off, but the iPhone X only sometimes rings. 

I had high expectations for this app given its great rating on the App Store, but it’s not dependable enough for me to trust right now as I’ve already been late to work and school a few times past due to its occasional failure to ring. 

For the developers, I see you’re very active in responding to reviews like these. I’ll do my best to provide you with information about my configuration that may help you replicate my observations. I appreciate your involvement and responsiveness, that’s what motivated me to leave this review. Thanks for working so diligently on this app, it makes life better for everyone.

title: When Working Well A+. However...
body: I initially thought this cool app changed my life: no more getting out of bed late, thinking ‘I’m up, I’m up!’ only to find myself 40 minutes late after dismissing several alarms. Alarmy changed all that, and I sang it’s praises to everyone with an iPhone. Solve math problems before taking your head off the pillow?! Shake the phone until you’re so annoyed you have no choice but to get up?! AND a white noise feature with different options of sound? An insomniac’s dream come true! Until my new best friend failed me. Miserably. It stopped making sounds, just shooting notifications on the home screen with no noise to accompany the messages. Now, when I just dismissed one alarm, two other alarms shut themselves off as well. Luckily I solved the math problems and didn’t need the others, but my dismay at seeing those extra alarms turn off in their own prompted me to write this review. When it’s working, it’s amazing!!! But if it’s not, let’s just say don’t rely on this app TOO much. If it’s too good to be true, it usually is!!!

title: I despise this app...because it works
body:
I used to be a morning person. I used to jump out of bed, ready to tackle the day! But slowly, over time, that changed. I’d recently been hitting snooze for 2 hours before I finally dragged myself out of bed. It didn’t matter how far away my phone was, I’d get up, turn the alarm off, and go back to sleep. I got to the point where I was fed up with myself and started searching around for options. This app came highly suggested and it’s free so I gave it a shot.

The night I got it, I tested it out to see how it would fare in the morning. When the alarm rang, I closed out of the app. It kept ringing. Silenced my phone. Kept ringing. Tried to turn the volume down. Kept. Freaking. Ringing. I chose to take a picture of something and while taking the picture to turn the alarm off, I could not get the conditions right. I spent a ridiculous amount of time trying to turn this thing off. 

After that, I had faith that it would work. By the time I turn the alarm off in the morning, I’m too mad to go back to bed. I keep my phone on airplane mode when I sleep so I have no issue with making sure DND is off and that the phone’s volume is on. No need to keep the app open in the background in that case.

Thank you to the developers for saving my butt. I still hate you. But I’m thankful nonetheless.

title: Don’t know what I can say that hasn’t already been said
body:
But I love this app. I’ve been hearing about it for months and finally decided I was ready to set myself a wake up schedule. 

I’ve gotten up on time almost every day this week (and the one time I didn’t had nothing to do with Alarmy). 

I even have a manual alarm I put on the other side of the room, and it doesn’t hold a candle to this. Something about having to do math just gets me up! And I love the news, weather, and horoscope screen (my tiny complaint is that the horoscope isn’t very well written, but that’s not a big deal). 

I haven’t tried the QR code or picture yet because the math has just been working so well. I got the app 6 or 7 days ago, and I happily bought the premium tonight after a week of getting up on time for the first time ever in my life. Honestly it works beautifully either way, but the ads were a tad annoying to look at, and this app is so well done that the creators totally deserve it. 

I don’t think there’s much else to say. Thank you for making this app, and I will cry if it ever goes away.

title: 10/10 would recommend
body:
As a college student with insomnia (not related to college) and difficulties waking up, I am extremely satisfied with Alarmy! I have tried sooo many techniques, apps, and alarm clocks, all of which I’ve been able to either sleep through or turn off in my sleep within the first couple of weeks. I love that I can set as many alarms as I’d like for different occasions and that each alarm can have a unique alarm task. I have all of mine set for math problems at carrying difficulties, and it’s proven very beneficial in stimulating my brain so I don’t go back to sleep after simply taking a picture or pressing a button.

Non-related to the alarm functions themselves, I absolutely love the screen emerging after wake up tasks have been successfully completed. Not only does it feature daily news, horoscope, and news widgets, but it also lists the day’s weather in comparison to the previous day. For example, if yesterday was sunny and 85 degrees, today’s reading might list the temperature as 77 and underneath would say, “8 degrees cooler than yesterday,” or, “rain showers on and off today. I have never seen this in any weather app, let alone an app in which meteorology is not the primary focus.

title: A LIFESAVER FOR STUDENTS - please read

Ok, so I’m a student who, most mornings, has to wake up at around 6 to get to school. I sleep pretty late because of schoolwork and I’m generally EXHAUSTED (and cranky) when I wake up. All my life I’ve slept through every single alarm ever. I guarantee you I’ve literally tried everything out there. Nothing gets me up! 

Anyway, I got this app because of the great reviews but without expecting it to change my life.. but it is a literal miracle! I finally get up (and fast too!) because the alarm is set up to an amplified volume that’s much louder than the lousy built in clock app on the IPhone. It’s honestly such a staple in my life now that I don’t know how I would be getting to classes on time otherwise. 

Also, it comes with useful features for people who need something to do before they are actually awake that beats just pressing snooze: you can set it to make you do some easy arithmetic problems or take a picture of something to stop the alarm. Includes weather and a nice daily horoscope :) 

One of my personal favorites is that you can fall asleep to relaxing noises like rainfall and thunder, crickets, a crackling fire, a gurgling stream I’m pretty sure, and some other great ones! You set the duration and it turns off automatically. 

TOTALLY RECOMMEND!!
10+ stars!!

title: Used to be great-EDIT
body:
Update:  First, I appreciate the response time from the programmers, who responded on this review and also via email.  After analyzing my usage, they reported that in order to operate properly, one of two things must happen:  Either the app has to be running (at least in the background), OR the phone volume has to be on.  While obviously I keep the app running, I do keep my phone on silent.  However, after an iOS update, there are often automatic updates that occur overnight that cause the app to close; thus, with the app closed and the phone on silent, the alarm doesn’t sound.  

When this app works, which is 98% of the time, IT WORKS.  Better than any app/alarm clock I’ve tried.  But my bosses are no longer ok with that 2%.  So I’ve solved the problem for me by having the app go off first and an actual alarm clock set across the room as back up.  The alarm clock by itself is no where near as effective as Alarmy, so until developers find a workaround other than leaving the phone’s sound on, I’ll have to double up.    

————————
Original:  
This app used to be the best.  Since the most recent iOS update, I have routinely had a problem where the alarm does not sound, but I have a million notifications in the morning that my alarm is going off.  I don’t use the Do Not Disturb feature.  Now that my job is on the line, I’m going to have to find another option.

title: It does what it says it does.
body:
I like this alarm a lot. It’s very easy to use, set up, and it wakes me up without fail every morning. The alarm sounds are loud and horrible, exactly what I need.

 It’s worth noting that you aren’t required to use the task feature (not the case for other alarm apps) and I really like that because I just need a loud, persistent alarm, not math or picture tasks. It does the job very well.

 I prefer this much more than Kiwake. 

Here’s some feed back to the developers: 

The morning feed could be more intuitive and useful, I really enjoy Apple News, and having something like that inside the app would be great, even if it was a monthly subscription service. 

The weather displays as Celsius, and I haven’t found an option to change to the US Fahrenheit standard. It’s not major, but it’d be nice to have that option. 

The horoscopes are becoming increasingly creepy, and a few times they’ve been exactly the same. One morning it was something like “You will die if you take any risks” this morning it was “Don’t chase the rabbit” I mean, it’s fine for me, but I’m probably one of the few who can see the humor in waking up to such dismal horoscopes. 

I’d like to be able to group my alarms into subcategories, create task lists, and use this as a reminder application rather than strictly a morning alarm. I think it’d make sense for people like myself who get easily distracted and need reminders. 

That’s all I have. 

All in all this is a no frills alarm app that has yet to fail to wake me up, or work. That’s a big plus over it’s competition.

The alarm won’t turn off unless, and only unless, you do the required activity, whether it’s scanning a particular QR code, taking a picture of your sink, or shaking the phone vigorously for 30 seconds. There’s no getting out of the required action. You can’t even force-close the app! My tired brain tried that this morning, but the app won the battle! It just kept creating notifications, and I didn’t want it to crash my phone, so I went and took the required picture and made it to my exercise class. 

This app just works. I highly recommend it.

title: Takes a Routine
body:
I had a tough time getting this to work at first but the company actually responded to my first review with tips. Basically I have to open the app before going to bed, and I check then that the phone isn’t silent or do-not-disturb mode. With those 3 things done the night before, this app works every time. I was having trouble before with the alarm not going off because I didn’t open the app before going to sleep. If you can handle the nightly routine this app is great and it really has gotten me up every morning no matter how tired I feel. 

I wish the nightly routine instructions were spelled out more clearly at the start so there wouldn’t be so much confusion for the first couple weeks. I also wish there was a way to disable the news feed / weather screen that pops up after you turn off the alarm bc it’s annoying to close each time.

title: Saved by the bell
body:
Prior to Alarmy, I was a three to four snooze kinda gal - which was frustrating. I knew it wasn't healthy for me to snooze. I tried putting my phone in the hallway; I tried to open my curtains (to the chagrin of my husband). I even bought a light emitting clock to simulate daylight. Nothing worked. 

Alarmy saved the day. With their requirement to perform math, my brain became awake enough to convince myself not to return to bed. Granted, I still put my phone in the hallway - standing while doing math is hard in the morning - but the cognitive jolt Alarmy forces me to give myself did the trick. 

I've had it for a month and am no longer returning to bed after the alarm.

title: A picture is worth a thousand words
body:
Morning person or not, often there aren't enough hours in the day, and any alarm going off before 7-8 hours of sleep is difficult for most to oblige. 

I set my "dismiss" to require a picture of my open Bible downstairs. The alarm is a song I choose within my playlist, so it's not a bother with it sounding while I freshen up before going downstairs. 

While I sometimes think I'll just take a pic and go back to bed, by the time I get downstairs with brushed teeth and a washed face, I'm awake enough to read and start my day. 

Alarmy helps this morning person welcome sunrises again even with a night owl schedule several nights throughout the week.

title: Good-bye Snoozing
body: I am a serious over sleeper. I'm talking hitting the snooze button for 45 minutes minimum before shutting off my alarm. I needed something that would force me to get up. Alarmy does just that. I can limit the amount of times I snooze before the snooze button becomes disabled. I use the feature that has you take a picture of something in your house in order to disable the alarm. Choose your photo spot wisely, because your original picture will overlay on your camera and you have to try to line them up for the alarm to shut off. You can adjust the sensitivity if you're too groggy to do this task well in the morning. Just be careful not to leave your phone on silent or your alarm will not go off.

title: Annoying enough to wake you up
body: I was awoken by a cheerful tune, beckoning me to start my day, or even to snooze for a few more minutes. Upon groggily choosing the snooze option, I was met with seemingly innocent math problems- a small price between me and snooze. However, my brain decided these problems were about as difficult as putting toothpaste back in the tube- not impossible, but terribly annoying. After failing the problems, this cheerful tune continued to play, morphing into a mournful goodbye to the 5 minute snooze. Now completed, these math problems and this little app got my blood flowing, and my body out of bed- throwing the phone at the wall. In short: this app WORKS.

title: Exactly what I was looking for
body: I searched the entire App Store and this is the only app that didn't look sketchy. It seemed like most of the other apps wanted to record audio and track sleeping patterns which was too invasive for me. I originally was searching for something that would make me get up out of bed and do something to turn off the alarm but I decided to try the "shake your phone" and math features of this app instead. The good thing is, even the easier math problems take concentration to get right so by the time I get the alarm turned off, I'm fully awake which is great because with a normal alarm my problem is I could turn it off in my sleep or without waking up too much and end up sleeping in. You can customize what sounds play, what method you want to use to turn off the alarm (and further detail about those methods, for example, math: you can chose the amount of problems and difficulty). Also the sound that it plays default isn't frightening or obnoxious but it's still enough to awaken. Another convenient feature is that when you are setting what time you want to wake up, it shows you how many hours and minutes of sleep you'll get, so you don't have to lie awake thinking about how much sleep you'll get "if I go to sleep right now". I would recommend this for any heavy sleepers who need extra help waking up and staying up.

title: Alarmy don't PLAY!!
body:
After the previous alarm app stopped working for me, I decided to try out a new one. I was a LITTLE nervous about whether it would get me up or not, but this app did sure as hell proved me wrong. 😂😂 

I made sure I had my volume high before I went to sleep and this thing did NOT fail to wake me up. Though I'm not exactly a very deep sleeper. I consider myself in the middle... 

I'll definitely be using this on the regular now, especially since I'm going to be going to college this fall! Time to get back on that sleep schedule. 😆 Now I didn't get into all of the features yet, but what I CAN say is that one I really like is where you can play a sound to help you fall asleep. Perfect for one of those nights where even the silence is deafening and you need something there. I'd recommend if you have a hard time sleeping with it being too quiet. I use the rain one and it's sooo soothing. 

Also, the things you'd have to do to turn the alarm off like do a quick math problem or shake it a certain amount of times was certainly very different and unlike anything I've seen in the alarm apps I've used. I feel like that is helpful in a way that it's not as easy to fall back asleep doing that as opposed to just reaching over and pressing 'Snooze'. (I do that A LOT. 🙄) But yeah! I overall really like this app. I personally haven't had any problems with it so far. 😊

title: Works well except...
body:
So alarmy actually works to finally get me up and out of bed (yay)!  Here's the suggestion I have and why I didn't give it 5-stars. I set my alarm to my shower curtain (which has a design).  It worked like a charm the first 4 times. On the 5th, it kept telling me my pictures didn't match. I spent 20 minutes taking pictures of my shower curtain to turn the alarm off...not a great way to start the day. I tried turning the alarm down (wouldn't let me), I tried deleting the app (wouldn't let me), I tried google searching how to turn it off if this sort of thing happens (no answers).  Finally, I took a picture that matched well enough that it turned the alarm off. So my rec is if you're going to take a picture of something, in your alarmy settings it will have how closely the pictures need to resemble each other. I'd choose "medium". I changed my mode of turning off my alarm altogether after that (I now scan a barcode).  My only concern is that someday I'm going to forget to turn my alarm off before bed when I'm traveling or away from home and I'm going to face this same dilemma. Hopefully there's something in settings that I can choose for the alarm to only go off 3 times or something like that before it shuts off for good. 
Overall, I like the concept. It's the first thing I've tried that actually helps me get out of bed. I also set my alarm sound to "park" which is birds chirping and dogs barking. It blends into my sleep for just a bit before it gets loud enough to wake me up. I think it's a more pleasant way to get woken up over some electronic noise.

title: Annoying but I LOVE it
body:
Everybody hates alarms and so do I, sleeping through them is relaxing but dangerous because you can be late to work/school. Me being me, I can sleep through a lot of alarms and it's gotten to the point where I set 6 different alarms to make me stay awake but I always sleep through them.
I honestly didn't want to get this app at all because of the fact that I hate alarms, but I got the thought that because it has different missions to force you to stay awake (which is what I needed) I thought we'll give it a shot.
When I first got the app it was like your standard Iphone Alarm app layout. You choose your sound, time, when the alarm plays on the days, snooze--but the only difference is, is the missions. You can switch from math problems to shaking your phone to taking a picture. I thought the most abundant way to prove I was awake was to take a picture of my cat.
I admit, I didn't know how it worked and I definitely didn't think it would work, but it actually did!
When I was woken by the alarm it told me to take a picture of the picture I chose (my cat), and when I did the alarm finally stopped. This caused me to stay awake and get ready for work and start the day.

Overall even though I hate alarm apps, I LOVE ALARMY.

title: This app is changing my life.
body: I used to hit snooze way too many times but this app solves that problem! I've only tried the math problems and photo modes but both are great. I love how many customizable features there are. And that the timer makes sure you don't doze off while trying to dismiss the alarm. I usually set one alarm with the math problems and then a second alarm for a few minutes later to have me take a picture of something in the bathroom. That way I get my brain awake and then have to get out of bed. It would be nice if I could do both in only one alarm though. Maybe this is a feature in the pro version, I wouldn't know. The only problem I've noticed so far is that if I'm still trying to turn off the first alarm when I had the second one set to go off, the second one won't go off at all. Not even when I finish the first alarm. Then I don't have to get up so I run the risk off deciding to go back to sleep. Along a similar note, a good feature to add would be if you could chose to not be able to turn off the alarm except after it's gone off. Because sometimes if I wake up an hour or so before my alarm was going to go off, I'll just turn it off by flipping the switch and then sleep later than I had planned when I went to bed. When I'm half asleep like that I'm not strong-willed enough to decide that I still want to get up early. Maybe this is already a pro feature too. But other than that, it's a great app that's helping me be on time and be more productive in the morning! Thank you so much!

Second, while your phone is in smart mode the app will continuously alert you that it needs to be running in the background, and sure, that's easily fixed in settings, still an odd function to incorporate. Third, if you have any Alarmy alarms on, your standard iPhone alarm system will not play any alarms. This is why I decided to write this review. I use my phones alarm for many things through the day and the fact that in order for them to work I have to turn Alarmy off AND remember to set Alarmy back on before going to bed makes this app not so functional. 
Tl;dr Looks good, functionally annoying.

title: This thing works.
body:
I am one of those people who cannot wake up at all. I have multiple very loud alarms that go off, including Alexa which requires me to speak to turn it off. I still manage to turn them all off in my semi-consciousness state and go back to sleep. Next thing I know, I am waking up an hour past when I should be at work. Enough was enough, I got this app and WOW! I use the sound effect "noise". Its normal alarm volume except it is such a jumble of bad noises, you wake up no problem. THEN I have to solve 3 math problems to turn it off. This seems simple, and it is, but it ensures your brain is awake. If I REALLY need to be up for something, I will set it to shake which requires you to vigorously shake the Iphone to turn it off. Depending on the intensity you set its a workout. There is also a photo setting where you take a photo and must then match up camera to photo to turn off alarm but I fund this extremely difficult due to night vs morning lighting. 

5 Star app. Get it.

title: Great App
body:
Great app with a lot of different options. I have been using it for 101 days now and it really helps me get up in the morning. Highly customizable to suit your needs. After a couple weeks I found the options that worked best for me and haven't looked back! I have tried many other alarm apps and this one is by far the best! I am terrible at getting out of bed and this app has helped me greatly!

Suggested improvements:
1. Allow the app to function when you're closed out of it in case you forget to run it before you go to bed.

2. For the math problems, it would be nice if the snooze didn't reset your progress if it takes you longer than your 3/5/10 minutes to solve them.

3. Allow two or more options to both be used to turn the alarm off.  Example: take a picture and solve a math problem. For those days when it's really hard to wake up.

Even without these suggested changes, it is still a great app.

I had high hopes for Alarmy, but until these bugs are fixed I won't be using it.

title: IT WORKS!!!!
body:
I have fibromyalgia/chronic fatigue, & have not been able to get my sleep schedule changed. The way I do it is by waking up earlier [not fully rested, no matter what time I fell asleep the day before]. I fight hard not to nap all day [those of you who've had chronic fatigue know this is extremely difficult!] That causes me to feel very tired all day, so it becomes easier to go to bed easier that night! I continue this pattern until I naturally get sleepy at the time I want to & can wake up at the time I want.

Anyway, I have been trying to do this for the past month with no success. When my alarm goes off, I am SO SO FATIGUED, I just cannot get up!!! I often don't remember shutting off/snoozing my alarms at least 3, sometimes 10 times!!

I tried this alarm this morning, & it worked!! I did the 30 shakes— while laying there trying to shake my phone, I couldn't figure out how to shake it for it to count! It frustrated me so badly, I probably shook my phone 3-4 times more than the number listed! Frustrated as I was at first, I became amused at how my frustration & vigorous shaking of my phone was waking me up!!! 😂 

Then my next alarm was to take a photo of an item in my dining room— that forced me to turn our very bright "daylight" light bulbs on to get the photo. 

For those of you who struggle with chronic fatigue or just being tired to get up earlier, TRY THIS APP!!

title: Wakes me up when the others don't
body:
tl;dr: it works. Wakes me up, won't let me go back to sleep. As with any good alarm, I despise it. That is its job! :)

Not quite five stars, but five stars in that it does exactly what it says it will do: it wakes you up and won't shut up until you've passed a predetermined verification -- some action you've specified that indicates you're probably really awake. When you're setting it up, I recommend setting a silent alarm for the next minute so you can get a feel for how to dismiss the alarm. Go through the tutorial first, and then make sure you do a trial run of an alarm with the specific wake-up test you've selected. I used an alarm with no sound to do that test, just in case I couldn't figure out the verification. 

I absolutely want an alarm that will not stop until I've passed some kind of verification that I'm actually awake. Otherwise I'll blithely dismiss it and go back to sleep. In my case, a photograph of something in another room is adequate. Even the act of aligning a photo of my bedside lamp is interruptive enough to get me upright. I need the alarm to get louder and louder, and to time out if I fail the task at hand. This app does that. When you're having trouble getting up and have a history of ignoring/dismissing multiple alarms, having one that persists, changes volume, and forces you to take a deliberate action is really important.

The warnings about when it will and will not work were a bit murky and could benefit from clarification. It does not look like it's necessary to leave the app in the foreground-- just don't kill it. My phone was in silent mode, as it usually is when I'm asleep. I didn't quite trust the app, so I kept my system alarms on-- those also functioned as expected. Just like the system alarm, Alarmy sounded off anyway (that, too, is good.) In summary, the app worked and didn't interfere with my usual routine or settings. 

Room for improvement: I would happily pay for an ad-free and more customizable version of the app. In its current incarnation, it's a decent compromise. Having additional wakefulness tests would be nice, as would an optional, delayed "are you still up?" feature. 

My rating is actually closer to, say, 4.2 stars, but I bumped up to five because the one-star reviews seem to describe what's *good* about the app. It's an alarm and it's supposed to be obnoxious. When system alarms don't cut it and you sleep right through the gentle iOS Bedtime soft music, this can help.

title: Bought Alarmy Pro, can’t restore purchase. User feedback link goes to dead end.
body: I bought Alarmy Pro years ago. Every now and then I have to uninstall it and reinstall it. I had to do that 3 days ago, and I still cannot get the app to restore my purchase. All I wanted was to ask support for help, but the “user feedback” link goes to a list of help FAQs with now way to contact support. I am in one of the busiest periods of my life and the last thing I need is to struggle for days to get my alarm to work so that I don’t oversleep. I am giving this app a 1 star rating in the hopes that somebody on the Alarmy team will see this and get in touch with me to help me. Quite frankly, this is a terrible thing to have to resort to just to get an issue heard and resolved. Alarmy, you can do better!
